docs.title: DETAILED DESCRIPTION OF EXAMPLE NON-LIMITING EMBODIMENTS
docs.text:
[0046] Embodiments of this disclosure are directed to a new synchronization primitive and an associated hardware-implemented synchronization unit. Example embodiments provide a flexibility offered by software barrier implementations, and an efficiency offered by conventional hardware barrier implementations mentioned above. In addition, the new synchronization primitive and associated application programming interface (API) and Instruction Set Architecture (ISA) support efficient increased concurrency across different hardware partitions offered for example by the cooperative group array (CGA) constructs of new GPU implementations.

[0046] 本公开的实施例针对一种新的同步原语及相关联的硬件实现同步单元。示例实施例提供了软件屏障实现所具备的灵活性，以及上述传统硬件屏障实现所提供的效率。此外，该新同步原语及相关的应用程序编程接口（API）和指令集架构（ISA）支持在不同硬件分区之间实现高效的高并发性，这些硬件分区例如由新型 GPU 实现中的协作组阵列（CGA）构造提供。

[0047] Strong scaling was described above in relation to FIG. 1A-1C, and refers to GPU design improvements such that the same amount of work (compared to a previous generation of GPU) can be performed at multiple times the speed on a faster processor. This effectively reduces the tile size allocated to each processor. To achieve strong scaling, GPU designers prefer to have tiles that are as small as possible. The shrinking per-processor, such as, for example, a streaming multiprocessor (SM), workload size tends to hurt data reuse and thus requires higher data feeding rate. On the other hand, the math throughput within a SM also tends to increase in each generation, which also demands for higher data feeding bandwidth.

[0047] 强缩放已在图1A-1C的相关部分描述，指的是GPU设计改进使得相同的工作量（与上一代GPU相比）可以在更快的处理器上以数倍速度完成。这有效地减少了分配给每个处理器的分块大小。为了实现强缩放，GPU设计者倾向于使用尽可能小的分块。每个处理器（例如，流式多处理器(SM)）上工作负载规模的缩小往往会损害数据重用，从而要求更高的数据供给速率。另一方面，SM内部的数学吞吐量在每一代中也趋于增加，这同样要求更高的数据供给带宽。

[0048] Since wires are expensive and do not scale as well as processing bandwidth, brute-force adding wires for extra bandwidth is no longer a feasible option. Instead, embracing locality is viewed as a more promising design choice. The goal of the embodiments described herein is to enable efficient data sharing and localized communication at a level greater than one SM. Besides new cross-SM cooperation mechanisms, proper synchronization primitives play a critical role in such design.

[0048] 由于连线成本高昂且扩展性远不及处理带宽，简单地通过增加连线来提升带宽已不再是可行方案。相反，利用局部性被视为更具前景的设计选择。本文描述的实施例旨在实现超越单个SM层次的高效数据共享与局部化通信。除新的跨SM协作机制外，恰当的同步原语在此类设计中亦起着关键作用。

[0049] Conventionally, CUDA provides the hardware named barrier as its core synchronization primitive which mostly follows the BSP (Bulk Synchronous Parallel) model.

[0049] 按照惯例，CUDA 提供了一种名为 barrier 的硬件作为其核心同步原语，该原语主要遵循 BSP（批量同步并行）模型。

The arrive-wait barrier described in U.S. patent application Ser. No. 16/712,236 filed Dec. 12, 2019 was introduced to better serve the producer-consumer style synchronization. However, named barriers and arrive-wait barriers while highly useful each have their own weaknesses. For example, a hardware named barrier is a dedicated processor-local resource that provides a limited number of barriers and which is difficult to expose to software, may be incompatible with the thread programming model, may provide inefficient support for producer-consumer communication, and may be hard to extend to cross-processor synchronization. The arrive-wait barrier does not suffer from many of these disadvantages but is often implemented as a shared-memory backed resource that provides a software-polling based wait operation. Such an arrive-wait barrier may incur a latency exposure and a substantial bandwidth cost to shared memory traffic. For example, given the extensive additional cross-processor guaranteed concurrency the CGA programming model provides, more efficient cross-processor asynchronous data exchange and associated synchronization could result in substantial performance improvements by reducing bandwidth requirements across long data paths between parallel processors.

2019年12月12日提交的美国专利申请第16/712,236号中描述的到达-等待屏障是为了更好地服务于生产者-消费者式同步而引入的。然而，命名屏障和到达-等待屏障虽然非常有用，但各自有其弱点。例如，硬件命名屏障是一种专用的处理器本地资源，提供的屏障数量有限，且难以暴露给软件，可能与线程编程模型不兼容，可能对生产者-消费者通信提供低效支持，并且难以扩展到跨处理器同步。到达-等待屏障避免了这些缺点中的许多，但通常被实现为由共享内存支持的资源，提供基于软件轮询的等待操作。这样的到达-等待屏障可能会对共享内存流量带来延迟暴露和显著的带宽成本。例如，由于CGA编程模型提供了广泛的额外跨处理器保证并发性，更高效的跨处理器异步数据交换及相关同步可以通过降低并行处理器之间长数据路径上的带宽需求，实现显著的性能提升。

[0050] In this disclosure, a new barrier type referred to herein as a "transaction barrier" is introduced to provide synchronization semantics for threads and for cross-processor and other asynchronous data exchanges. A dedicated hardware unit or device referred to herein as the "synchronization unit" is also provided to enable transaction barrier operations to be highly efficient.

[0050] 在本公开中，引入了一种称为“transaction barrier”的新型屏障类型，用于为线程以及跨处理器和其他异步数据交换提供同步语义。还提供了一种称为“synchronization unit”的专用硬件单元或设备，以使事务屏障操作能够高效执行。

[0051] The transaction barrier can extend or replace the shared-memory backed arrive-wait barrier in certain implementations, sharing its advantages over the conventional hardware named barrier. That is, at least in some embodiments, the transaction barrier is a fully software-managed resource with a clear software exposure story, a thread compatible programming model and efficient producer-consumer communication pattern support. In an environment such as, for example, a GPU incorporating "cooperative group arrays (CGA)", described in U.S. patent application Ser. No. 17/691,621, and distributed shared memory, described in U.S. patent application Ser. No. 17/691,690, the transaction barrier can receive arrival updates from cooperative thread arrays (CTAs, where a CGA includes a plurality of CTAs) in the same CGA that are running on different SMs, extending the synchronization scope to cross-SM/cross-processor arrangements.

[0051] 事务屏障在某些实现中可以扩展或替代基于共享内存的到达-等待屏障，同时具备其相对于传统硬件命名屏障的优势。也就是说，至少在一些实施例中，事务屏障是一种完全由软件管理的资源，具有清晰的软件呈现方式、线程兼容的编程模型以及对高效生产者-消费者通信模式的支持。在例如包含美国专利申请第17/691,621号所述的“协作组阵列（CGA）”以及美国专利申请第17/691,690号所述的分布式共享内存的GPU等环境中，事务屏障可以接收来自同一CGA中运行在不同SM上的协作线程阵列（CTA，其中一个CGA包含多个CTA）的到达更新，从而将同步范围扩展到跨SM/跨处理器配置。

[0052] In addition to the thread-arrival tracking capability of the arrive-wait barrier, the transaction barrier introduces the new capability of transaction-arrival tracking and allows user threads to synchronize against both other user threads and asynchronous hardware transactions, which may be generated during, or as a result of, execution of asynchronous data movement features. This new transaction tracking capability may enable the following example data sharing and localized communication patterns, which ultimately lead to strong scaling, from a programming model's perspective:

[0052] 除了到达-等待屏障的线程到达跟踪能力之外，事务屏障引入了事务到达跟踪这一新能力，并允许用户线程与其它用户线程以及异步硬件事务进行同步，这些异步硬件事务可能是在异步数据移动特性执行期间或作为其结果产生的。从编程模型的角度看，这种新的事务跟踪能力能够实现以下示例性的数据共享和局部通信模式，并最终带来强扩展性：

[0053] A group of consumer CTAs knowing when data is ready when receiving multicast memory data from loads issued by one producer CTA, thus saving bandwidth on layer 2 (L2) cache and interconnection (an example multicast implementation is described in U.S. patent application Ser. No. 17/691,406);

[0053] 一组消费者CTA在接收由一个生产者CTA发出的加载操作的多播内存数据时，能够知晓数据已就绪，从而节省了第二层（L2）缓存和互连的带宽（一种示例性的多播实现方式描述于美国专利申请序列号17/691,406中）；

[0054] Direct inter-CTA localized data communication with "speed of light" (SOL, half round-trip) synchronization latency (described in U.S. patent application Ser. No. 17/691,303) within the CGA, thus saving both L2 cache/interconnection bandwidth and synchronization latency; and

[0054] 在 CGA 内进行直接的 CTA 间本地化数据通信，具有“光速”（SOL，半往返）同步延迟（如美国专利申请第 17/691,303 号所述），从而同时节省 L2 缓存/互连带宽和同步延迟；以及

[0055] Direct inter-CTA localized synchronization within CGA, saving round-trip latency to global memory.

[0055] 在 CGA 内直接进行跨 CTA 的局部同步，从而节省了往返全局内存的延迟。

[0056] In some embodiments, the synchronization unit provides the desired hardware acceleration to the entire, or substantial portion of the, semantic set defined by the transaction barrier, especially the transaction tracking capabilities that are highly integrated with the asynchronous data exchange features supported by the transaction barrier. A hardware waiting acceleration capability provided in the synchronization unit eliminates, or at least drastically reduces, the latency cost associated with the conventional polling loop used in conventional implementations, and may also integrate with other synchronization hardware circuits such as, for example, a convergence barrier unit (CBU) for native thread programming model support. In some embodiments, a caching and coalescing capability in the synchronization unit minimizes the bandwidth cost incurred due to synchronization traffic.

[0056] 在一些实施例中，同步单元为事务屏障界定的整个语义集或其实质性部分提供所需的硬件加速，特别是与事务屏障支持的异步数据交换功能高度集成的事务跟踪能力。同步单元中提供的硬件等待加速能力消除了、或至少大幅降低了传统实现中使用的常规轮询循环带来的延迟成本，并且还可与其他同步硬件电路集成，例如与收敛屏障单元(CBU)集成以支持原生线程编程模型。在一些实施例中，同步单元中的缓存与合并能力最大限度地减少了因同步流量而产生的带宽成本。

[0057] The transaction barrier and the synchronization unit described in this disclosure may provide several new capabilities and properties such as, for example, those described in the next seven paragraphs.

[0057] 本公开中描述的事务屏障和同步单元可以提供几种新的能力和特性，例如在接下来的七段中描述的那些。

[0058] The transaction barrier tracks both thread arrival and transaction arrival, and allows user threads to synchronize against both at the same time. In some embodiments, transaction arrival may be tracked by a zero-balanced counter without a pre-armed expectation count. The expectation on transaction count may be programmed by the user on each usage of the barrier.

[0058] 事务屏障同时追踪线程到达和事务到达，并允许用户线程同时针对两者进行同步。在一些实施例中，事务到达可以通过一个零平衡计数器来追踪，无需预先设置的期望计数。事务计数的期望可以由用户在该屏障的每次使用时进行编程设置。

[0059] The transaction barrier places only minimal requirements on the relative ordering between different arrival events. The expectation can be set by any participating thread before its arrival on the barrier, before or after the associated data transactions. For example, both producer and consumer threads can program the expectation (see FIGS. 6A and 6B), whichever fits a particular usage scenario better.

[0059] 事务屏障仅对不同到达事件之间的相对顺序提出最低要求。期望可由任何参与线程在其到达屏障之前设定，可在关联数据事务之前或之后。例如，生产者线程和消费者线程均可编程该期望（参见图6A和图6B），具体取决于哪一种方式更适合特定的使用场景。

[0060] The transaction barrier may provide synchronization semantics for capabilities such as copy engines (e.g., direct memory access (DMA) units), the CGA feature (described in U.S. patent application Ser. No. 17/691,621), "speed-of-light" data exchange between SMs (described in U.S. patent application Ser. No. 17/691,303), programmatic multicast (described in U.S. patent application Ser. No. 17/691,288), and the tensor memory access unit (TMAU) (described in U.S. patent application Ser. No. 17/691,276 and in U.S. application Ser. No. 17/691,422), and other data movement operations performed by hardware units.

[0060] 事务屏障可为复制引擎（例如直接内存访问（DMA）单元）、CGA 特性（记载于美国专利申请第 17/691,621 号）、SM 间的“光速”数据交换（记载于美国专利申请第 17/691,303 号）、程序化多播（记载于美国专利申请第 17/691,288 号）以及张量内存访问单元（TMAU）（记载于美国专利申请第 17/691,276 号及美国申请第 17/691,422 号）等能力，以及硬件单元执行的其他数据移动操作提供同步语义。

[0061] The synchronization unit provides programmability through general primitives to emulate non-standard synchronization patterns that are not directly built into the hardware.

[0061] 该同步单元通过通用原语提供可编程性，以模拟硬件未直接内置的非标准同步模式。

[0062] The synchronization unit may provide hardware accelerated waiting support on software managed synchronization objects in memory. Both pre-defined transaction barriers and user-defined synchronization objects are supported by the accelerated waiting.

[0062] 同步单元可以为内存中由软件管理的同步对象提供硬件加速等待支持。加速等待支持预定义的事务屏障和用户定义的同步对象。

[0063] The synchronization unit provides thread programming model support for transaction barrier acceleration. Each thread can participate in the transaction barrier synchronization based on its independent decision. No functional requirement is imposed on warp-synchronous execution. For waiting operations, the thread semantics is maintained through integration with the convergence barrier unit (CBU).

[0063] 同步单元为事务屏障加速提供线程编程模型支持。各线程可根据其独立决策参与事务屏障同步。对于 warp 同步执行，未施加任何功能要求。针对等待操作，通过与收敛屏障单元 (CBU) 集成，保持了线程语义。

[0064] The synchronization unit may be deeply integrated with asynchronous data exchange features designs, providing aggressive caching and coalescing to minimize the bandwidth cost from the synchronization traffic. The asynchronous data exchange features include, but are not limited to: DMA and like copy engines, programmatic multicast, TMA unit, SOL data exchange between SMs and certain load/store commands (e.g., the fused atomic load/store command (LDGSTS) in some embodiments).

[0064] 同步单元可以与异步数据交换特性设计深度集成，通过积极的缓存与合并操作来尽可能降低同步流量带来的带宽成本。这些异步数据交换特性包括但不限于：DMA及类似的复制引擎、编程多播、TMA单元、SM之间的SOL数据交换，以及某些加载/存储命令（例如某些实施例中的融合原子加载/存储命令（LDGSTS））。

docs.title: Overview of Example GPU Environment
docs.text:
[0065] FIG. 2 shows an example GPU environment in which the transaction barrier may be implemented in some embodiments.

[0065] 图2示出了在一些实施例中可以实现事务屏障的示例GPU环境。

[0066] The illustrated GPU shows how some GPU implementations may enable plural partitions that operate as micro GPUs such as the shown micro GPU0 and micro GPU1, where each micro GPU includes a portion of the processing resources of the overall GPU. When the GPU is partitioned into two or more separate smaller micro GPUs for access by different clients, resources including the physical memory devices such as local L2 cache memories-are also typically partitioned. For example, in one design, a first half of the physical memory devices coupled to micro GPU0 may correspond to a first set of memory partition locations and a second half of the physical memory devices coupled to micro GPU1 may correspond to a second set of memory partition locations. Performance resources within the GPU are also partitioned according to the two or more separate smaller processor partitions. The resources may include level two cache (L2) resources and processing resources. One embodiment of such a Multi-Instance GPU ("MIG") feature allows the GPU to be securely partitioned into many separate GPU Instances for CUDA ("Compute Unified Device Architecture") applications, providing multiple users with separate GPU resources to accelerate their respective applications. More particularly, each micro GPU includes a plurality of Graphic Processing Clusters (GPC) each with a plurality of SMs. Each GPC connects to the L2 cache via a crossbar interconnect.

[0066] 该图示GPU展示了某些GPU实现如何支持多个分区，这些分区作为如所示的微型GPU0和微型GPU1这样的微型GPU运行，其中每个微型GPU包含整体GPU的一部分处理资源。当GPU被划分为两个或更多独立的较小微型GPU以供不同客户端访问时，包括物理内存设备（如本地L2缓存内存）在内的资源通常也会被分区。例如，在一种设计中，与微型GPU0耦合的物理内存设备的前半部分可对应第一组内存分区位置，而与微型GPU1耦合的物理内存设备的另一半可对应第二组内存分区位置。GPU内的性能资源也根据这两个或更多独立的较小处理器分区进行划分。这些资源可能包括二级缓存(L2)资源与处理资源。此类多实例GPU（“MIG”）特性的一个实施例允许GPU被安全地划分为多个独立的GPU实例，用于CUDA（“计算统一设备架构”）应用程序，从而为多个用户提供独立的GPU资源以加速其各自的应用程序。更具体地，每个微型GPU包含多个图形处理集群(GPC)，每个集群具有多个SM。每个GPC通过交叉开关互连连接到L2缓存。

[0067] Each GPC includes a plurality of streaming multiprocessors (SM) that are each a massively parallel processor including a plurality of processor cores, register files, and specialized units such as load/store units, texture units, etc. A memory management unit (MMU) in each GPC interconnects the SMs on the same GPC, and also provides each SM with access to the memory including L2 cache and other memory. The GPCs in the same micro GPU are interconnected by a crossbar switch, and the micro-GPUs are interconnected by the respective crossbar switches. The GPU may additionally have copy engines and other 10 units and links for external connections. For more information on prior GPU hardware and how it has advanced, see for example U.S. Pat. Nos. 8,112,614; 7,506,134; 7,836,118; 7,788,468; U.S. Ser. No. 10/909,033; US20140122809; Lindholm et al, "NVIDIA Tesla: A Unified Graphics and

[0067] 每个GPC包括多个流式多处理器（SM），每个流式多处理器都是一个大规模并行处理器，包括多个处理器核心、寄存器文件，以及诸如加载/存储单元、纹理单元等专用单元。每个GPC中的内存管理单元（MMU）将同一GPC上的SM互连，并且还为每个SM提供对包括L2缓存和其他内存在内的内存的访问。同一微型GPU中的GPC通过交叉开关互连，而微型GPU之间则通过各自的交叉开关互连。GPU还可以具有复制引擎以及其他10个单元和用于外部连接的链路。有关现有GPU硬件及其演进方式的更多信息，请参见例如美国专利号8,112,614；7,506,134；7,836,118；7,788,468；美国专利申请号10/909,033；US20140122809；Lindholm等人，“NVIDIA Tesla: A Unified Graphics and

Computing Architecture," IEEE Micro (2008); https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/parallel-thread-execution/index.html (retrieved 2021); Choquette et al, "Volta: Performance and Programmability", IEEE Micro (Volume: 38, Issue: 2, Mar./ Apr. 2018), DOI: 10.1109/MM.2018.022071134.

“计算体系结构”，《IEEE Micro》（2008年）；https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/parallel-thread-execution/index.html（检索于2021年）；Choquette等人，《Volta：性能与可编程性》，《IEEE Micro》（第38卷，第2期，2018年3月/4月），DOI：10.1109/MM.2018.022071134。

[0068] FIGS. 3A-3D show schematic illustrations of example inter-SM communication within a GPC in an example GPU such as that shown in FIG. 2. Inter-SM communication ("SM2SM" communication) occurs when a first SM transmits a message via a MMU to a crossbar that interconnects all the SMs in the GPC. Memory access requests to the L2 cache, are communicated through the same crossbar interconnect to the L2 cache. In some embodiments, the GPU includes a distributed memory such that inter-SM communication may include data operations from one SM to a portion of another SMs memory. An example distributed memory feature is described in U.S. patent application Ser. No. 17/691,690. One of the messages that an SM can communicate to another SM is the local_ cga_id of a CTA the SM is executing (CGA are described below in relation to FIG. 4). In one embodiment, the packet format of such an SM-to-SM message includes a U008 field "gpc_local_cga_id". Each GPC has its own pool of CGA IDs, and GPM allocates one of those numbers to a CGA upon launch of that CGA. This assigned number then serves e.g., as a pointer into the DSMEM distributed memory segments that are being used by the various CTAs in the CGA. In one embodiment, the "gpc_local_cga_id" also serves as the id for tracking barrier state for each GPC_ CGA.

[0068] 图3A-3D示出了示例性GPU（例如图2所示的GPU）中GPC内SM间通信的示意性图示。当一个SM通过MMU向互连GPC中所有SM的交叉开关传输消息时，就会发生SM间通信（“SM2SM”通信）。对L2缓存的内存访问请求，通过同一交叉开关互连传到L2缓存。在一些实施例中，GPU包含分布式内存，使得SM间通信可包括从一个SM到另一个SM的某部分内存的数据操作。美国专利申请序列号17/691,690中描述了示例性的分布式内存特性。SM可以向另一个SM通信的消息之一是该SM正在执行的CTA的local_cga_id（CGA将在下文结合图4描述）。在一个实施例中，此类SM到SM消息的数据包格式包含一个U008字段“gpc_local_cga_id”。每个GPC都有自己的CGA ID池，GPM在启动某个CGA时，会从这些编号中分配一个给该CGA。然后，这个分配的编号例如用作指向该CGA中各个CTA正在使用的DSMEM分布式内存段的指针。在一个实施例中，“gpc_local_cga_id”也用作追踪每个GPC_CGA的屏障状态的id。

[0069] FIG. 4 illustrates an arrangement of blocks of threads in a Cooperative Group Array (CGA), according to some embodiments. A CGA is a new programming/execution model and supporting hardware implementation and is described in the concurrently filed U.S. patent application Ser. No. 17/691,621, which is herein incorporated by reference in its entirety. In some embodiments, the transaction barrier and synchronization unit described in this disclosure rely upon the CGA programming/execution model. The CGA programming/execution model enables adjacent tiles to be launched into SMs on the same GPC.

[0069] 图4示出了根据一些实施例的协作组阵列(CGA)中的线程块布局。CGA是一种新的编程/执行模型及支持的硬件实现，并在同时提交的序列号为17/691,621的美国专利申请中进行了描述，该申请通过引用将其全部内容并入本文。在一些实施例中，本公开中描述的事务屏障与同步单元依赖于CGA编程/执行模型。CGA编程/执行模型使得相邻的瓦片能够被启动到同一GPC上的SM中。

[0070] In one embodiment, a CGA is a collection of CTAs where hardware guarantees that all CTAs of the CGA are launched to the same hardware organization level the CGA specifies or is associated with. The hardware is configured to make sure there are enough processing resources in the target hardware level to launch all CTAs of the CGA before launching any.

在一个实施例中，CGA 是一组 CTA 的集合，硬件保证该 CGA 中的所有 CTA 都会在 CGA 所指定或关联的同一硬件组织级别上启动。硬件被配置为确保目标硬件级别中有足够的处理资源，以便在启动任何其他 CTA 之前，先启动该 CGA 的全部 CTA。

[0071] As FIG. 4 shows, a CGA is a grid of clusters of thread blocks or CTAs organized as an array. Such CGAs provide co-scheduling, e.g., control over where clusters of CTAs are placed/executed in the GPU, relative to the memory required by an application and relative to each other. This enables applications to see more data locality, reduced latency, and better synchronization between all the threads in tightly cooperating clusters of CTAs.

[0071] 如图4所示，CGA是由线程块或CTA集群组成的网格，这些集群以数组形式组织。此类CGA提供协同调度，例如，控制CTA集群在GPU中相对于应用所需内存以及相互之间的放置/执行位置。这使得应用能够获得更高的数据局部性、减少的延迟，并在紧密协作的CTA集群中的所有线程之间实现更好的同步。

[0072] For example, CGAs let an application take advantage of the hierarchical nature of the interconnect and caching subsystem in modern GPUs and make it easier to scale as chips grow in the future. By exploiting spatial locality, CGAs allow more efficient communication and lower latency data movement. GPU hardware improvements guarantee that threads of plural CTAs the new CGA hierarchical level(s) define will run concurrently for desired spatial localities, by allowing CGAs to control where on the machine the concurrent CTA threads will run relative to one another.

[0072] 例如，CGA 使应用程序能够利用现代 GPU 中互连和缓存子系统的层次化特性，并随着未来芯片规模的增大而更易于扩展。通过利用空间局部性，CGA 实现了更高效的通信和更低延迟的数据移动。GPU 硬件改进保证，由新 CGA 层级所定义的多个 CTA 的线程将并发运行以实现所需的空间局部性，其方式是允许 CGA 控制这些并发 CTA 线程在机器上的相对运行位置。

[0073] In one embodiment, CGAs are composed of clusters of CTAs that are guaranteed by hardware to launch and execute simultaneously/concurrently. The CTAs in a CGA cluster may and in the general case will execute on different SMs within the GPU. Even though the CTAs execute on different SMs, the GPU hardware/system nevertheless provides a cross-SM guarantee that the CTAs in a CGA cluster will be scheduled to execute concurrently. The GPU hardware/system also provides efficient mechanisms by which the concurrently-executing CTAs can communicate with one another. This allows an application to explicitly share data between the CTAs in a CGA cluster and also enables synchronization between the various threads of the CTAs in the CGA cluster.

[0073] 在一个实施例中，CGA 由 CTA 集群组成，硬件保证这些 CTA 能够同时/并发地启动与执行。CGA 集群中的 CTA 可能且通常会在 GPU 内不同的 SM 上执行。尽管这些 CTA 在不同的 SM 上执行，GPU 硬件/系统仍然会提供跨 SM 的保证，即 CGA 集群中的 CTA 将被调度以并发执行。GPU 硬件/系统还提供了高效的机制，使得并发执行的 CTA 之间能够相互通信。这使得应用程序可以在 CGA 集群的 CTA 之间显式地共享数据，并支持 CGA 集群中各 CTA 的线程之间进行同步。

[0074] In example embodiments, the various threads within the CGA cluster can read/write from common shared memory enabling any thread in the CGA cluster to share data with any other thread in the cluster. Sharing data between CTAs in the CGA cluster saves interconnect and memory bandwidth which is often the performance limiter for an application.

[0074] 在示例实施例中，CGA 集群内的各个线程都可以从公共共享内存中读取/写入，这使得 CGA 集群中的任何线程都能与集群内任何其他线程共享数据。在 CGA 集群中的 CTA 之间共享数据可以节省互连和内存带宽，而这往往是应用程序的性能限制因素。

[0075] Now, using the concurrent execution and additional shared memory supported by hardware, it is possible to directly share data between threads of one CTA and threads of another CTA—enabling dependencies across CTAs that can bridge hardware (e.g., cross-SM) partitions.

现在，利用硬件支持的并发执行和额外共享内存，可以直接在一个 CTA 的线程与另一个 CTA 的线程之间共享数据——从而实现跨 CTA 的依赖关系，这种依赖关系可以跨越硬件（例如跨 SM）分区。

[0076] Because CGAs guarantee all their CTAs execute concurrently with a known spatial relationship, other hardware optimizations are possible such as: Multicasting data returned from memory to multiple SMs (CTAs) to save interconnect bandwidth as in embodiments of this disclosure; Direct SM-to-SM communication for lower latency data sharing and improved synchronization between producer and consumer threads in the CGA; Hardware barriers for synchronizing execution across all (or any) threads in a CGA; and more (see copending commonly-assigned patent applications listed above).

[0076] 由于CGA保证其所有CTA以已知的空间关系并发执行，因此其他硬件优化成为可能，例如：将从内存返回的数据多播到多个SM（CTA），以节省互连带宽，如本公开的实施例所述；直接的SM到SM通信，用于更低延迟的数据共享，并改善CGA中生产者和消费者线程之间的同步；硬件屏障，用于同步CGA中所有（或任意）线程的执行；以及更多（参见上文列出的共同未决的共同受让专利申请）。

[0077] The additional cluster overlay provided by the CGA defines where and when the CTAs will run, and in particular, guarantees that all CTAs of a CGA will run concurrently within a common hardware domain that provides dynamic sharing of data, messaging and synchronization between the CTAs.

CGA提供的额外集群覆盖层定义了CTA在何处以及何时运行，特别是保证一个CGA中的所有CTA都能在一个共同的硬件域内并发运行，该硬件域提供CTA之间的数据动态共享、消息传递和同步。

[0078] In example embodiments, all CTA threads within a CGA may reference various types of commonly-accessible shared memory. Hardware support in the GPU allows the different CTAs in a CGA cluster to read and write each other's shared memory. Thus, load, store and atomic memory accesses by a first CTA can target shared memory of a second CTA, where the first and second CTAs are within the same CGA cluster. In some embodiments, the source multicast SM writes to the receiver multicast SMs in their respective memories using a distributed memory mechanism. An example distributed memory that may be used in embodiments is described in U.S. application Ser. No. 17/691,690, which is incorporated herein by reference in its entirety. In some example embodiments, the distributed shared memory of the respective SMs is mapped into generic address space.

[0078] 在示例实施例中，CGA内的所有CTA线程均可引用多种类型可共同访问的共享内存。GPU中的硬件支持使CGA集群内的不同CTA能够读写彼此的共享内存。因此，第一CTA的加载、存储和原子内存访问可以针对第二CTA的共享内存，其中第一和第二CTA位于同一CGA集群内。在一些实施例中，源多播SM使用分布式内存机制向接收多播SM的各自内存写入。实施例中可使用的示例分布式内存，在美国专利申请序列号17/691,690中有所描述，其全文以引用方式并入本文。在一些示例实施例中，各SM的分布式共享内存被映射到通用地址空间。

docs.title: Transaction Barrier Data Structure
docs.text:
[0079] FIG. 5A shows a data structure for a transaction barrier 500 in accordance with example embodiments. The transaction barrier 500 includes at least a arrive count 504 and a transaction count 508. The arrive count 504 keeps track of arrive operations, and the transaction count 508 keeps track of transactions. Arrives and transactions are further described below. The transaction barrier, when in a state in which the barrier is set so that threads are prevented (i.e. blocked) from progressing in their instruction execution, is cleared only upon both the arrive count 504 and the transaction count 508 satisfy a predetermined clearing condition. The predetermined clearing condition for the barrier, in an embodiment, is an expected number of arrives and an expected number of transaction completions having being reached at the barrier.

[0079] 图5A示出了根据示例实施例的事务屏障500的数据结构。事务屏障500至少包括到达计数504和事务计数508。到达计数504跟踪到达操作，事务计数508跟踪事务。到达操作和事务将在下文进一步说明。当事务屏障处于屏障被设置以阻止（即阻塞）线程继续执行其指令的状态时，仅当到达计数504和事务计数508都满足预定清除条件时，该屏障才被清除。在一个实施例中，屏障的预定清除条件是在屏障处已达到的预期到达操作数量和预期事务完成数量。

[0080] Additionally, in some embodiments, the transaction barrier 500 includes one or more other attributes such as a phase indicator 502, an expected arrive count 510, and a lock indicator 506. The phase indicator 502 is used to indicate a phase of the barrier. The value of the expected arrive count 510, which may be the number of arrives expected in each phase, is used to re-initialize the arrive count 504 after the barrier is cleared.

[0080] 另外，在一些实施方案中，事务屏障500包含一个或多个其他属性，例如阶段指示器502、预期到达计数510和锁定指示器506。阶段指示器502用于指示屏障所处的阶段。预期到达计数510的值（通常为每个阶段预期的到达次数）用于在屏障清除后重新初始化到达计数504。

[0081] The lock indicator 506 is used in some embodiments to disable updating of the barrier for reasons such as, for example, an error condition being detected subsequent to a thread arrival etc. In example embodiments in which a thread in one SM can operate on another threads' data in another SM, when the remote thread performs an illegal or unpermitted action, the lock indicator can be marked locked. The next time a local barrier operation is attempted, it will be notified to the local thread that the barrier is locked due to an error by the remote thread. This allows for tracking errors that may be caused by any of the many agents using the sync unit to cleanly handle errors.

[0081] 在一些实施例中，锁指示器506用于禁止屏障的更新，原因诸如在某个线程到达之后检测到错误条件等。在示例实施例中，其中一个SM中的线程可以对另一个SM中的另一个线程的数据进行操作，当远程线程执行非法或未允许的动作时，锁指示器可被标记为锁定。下一次尝试执行本地屏障操作时，会通知本地线程该屏障由于远程线程的错误而被锁定。这允许跟踪可能由使用同步单元的众多代理中的任何一个引起的错误，以便干净地处理错误。

[0082] FIG. 5B shows a transaction barrier 500 address, according to some embodiments. The barrier address 520 includes a unique value 522 that identifies the CGA and the CTAID for which the barrier is created, and a memory offset value 520 that indicates the offset at which the barrier is from the base address in the memory. As described above, in some embodiments, each CGA is allocated its own area in memory, and each CTA of that CGA is allocated its own subarea within the memory block of the CGA. The offset 520 defines the offset from the based address for the particular CTA that creates the transaction barrier 500. In some embodiments, the memory in which the barrier is stored is distributed shared memory that is accessible to all CTAs in the CGA.

[0082] 图5B示出了根据一些实施例的事务屏障500地址。屏障地址520包含一个唯一值522，用于标识创建该屏障的CGA和CTAID，以及一个内存偏移值520，指示该屏障在内存中相对于基地址的偏移量。如上所述，在一些实施例中，每个CGA在内存中分配有自己的区域，而该CGA的每个CTA在CGA的内存块内分配有自己的子区域。偏移量520定义了为创建事务屏障500的特定CTA相对于基地址的偏移。在一些实施例中，存储屏障的内存是分布式共享内存，可供CGA中的所有CTA访问。

docs.title: Transaction Barrier Operation
docs.text:
[0083] FIG. 6A illustrates a transaction barrier use by two producer CTAs ("Producer0" and "Producer1") and two consumer CTAs ("Consumer0" and "Consumer1"). The producers store data into buffer "DataBuf", and the consumers read from DataBuf. Producer0, Producer1, Consumer0 and Consumer1 may each be a thread in a respective CTA in the same CGA. The CTAs may be on the same SM or on two or more SMs.

[0083] 图6A示出了两个生产者CTA（“Producer0”和“Producer1”）和两个消费者CTA（“Consumer0”和“Consumer1”）使用事务屏障的情况。生产者将数据存储到缓冲区“DataBuf”中，消费者从DataBuf读取数据。Producer0、Producer1、Consumer0和Consumer1各自可以是同一CGA中相应CTA中的一个线程。这些CTA可以在同一个SM上，或者在两个或更多个SM上。

[0084] The illustrated producer-consumer interaction involves the two producers utilizing an arrive-wait barrier shown in the figure as "BarBufAvail" to determine the availability of space in a buffer "DataBuf" in which to store data produced by the producers, and the two consumers utilizing a transaction barrier shown in the figure as "Bar-DatRdy" to determine the availability of data in DataBuf to consume.

[0084] 图示的生产者-消费者交互涉及两个生产者利用图中所示的“BarBufAvail”到达-等待屏障来判断缓冲区“DataBuf”中用于存储生产者所产生数据的空间可用性，以及两个消费者利用图中所示的“Bar-DatRdy”事务屏障来判断DataBuf中可供消费的数据可用性。

[0085] The barriers define two phases "Phase0" and "Phase1", and each barrier starts in phase 0 at the beginning of the interaction.

[0085] 障碍定义了两个阶段“Phase0”和“Phase1”，并且在交互开始时，每个障碍都从阶段0开始。

[0086] The arrive-wait-barrier is initialized to phase 0 and arrival count -2 (P=0, Acnt=-2). The arrival count, while representing the number of expected thread arrivals at the arrive-wait barrier during phase 0 , is initialized to the negative value of the actual number of expected thread arrivals (e.g., -2 to represent an expected number of 2 thread arrivals) at the arrive-wait barrier. In this manner, in response to each thread arrival at barrier BarBufAvail, the arrival count can be updated by an increment operation (e.g., increase arrival count by 1).

[0086] 到达-等待屏障初始化为阶段0及到达计数-2（P=0, Acnt=-2）。到达计数，虽然表示阶段0期间在到达-等待屏障处预期的线程到达数量，却被初始化为实际预期线程到达数量的负值（例如，以-2表示预期2次线程到达）。这样，每当有线程到达屏障 BarBufAvail 时，便可通过递增操作更新到达计数（例如，将到达计数加1）。

[0087] The transaction barrier is initialized to phase 0, arrival count -2 and a transaction count \( 0\left( {\mathrm{P} = 0}\right. \) , Acnt \( = - 2 \) and Tcnt=0). The initialized arrival count represents that two thread arrivals are expected at the transaction barrier in phase 0 , and the transaction count represents a count of the data to be received also in the same phase.

[0087] 事务屏障被初始化为阶段0，到达计数-2，以及事务计数\( 0\left( {\mathrm{P} = 0}\right. \) , Acnt \( = - 2 \) 和 Tcnt=0）。初始化的到达计数表示在阶段0事务屏障处预期有两个线程到达，而事务计数表示同样在该阶段要接收的数据计数。

[0088] In the example, the transaction count represents a number of buffers expected to be exchanged between the producers and consumers. In example embodiments, in each phase, each transaction arrival updates the transaction counter with the number of expected transactions.

[0088] 在该示例中，事务计数表示预期在生产者与消费者之间交换的缓冲区数量。在示例实施例中，在每个阶段，每次事务到达时都会根据预期的事务数量更新事务计数器。

[0089] After the barriers are initialized, Producer0 and Producer1 threads wait on the arrive-wait barrier BarBu-fAvail, in phase 0, because DataBuf is full and has no space in which to store further data from the producers. Consumer0 and Consumer1 each reads respective buffers of DataBuf and updates the BarBufAvail barrier to indicate that some of the data in DataBuf has been consumed, by each incrementing the arrive count on BarBufAvail as a result of calling a thread arrive( ) function. When the arrive count on the BarBufAvail indicates that all the expected arrives have been received (i.e., Acnt=0), the BarBufAvail barrier is cleared, and BarBufAvail barrier moves to the next phase-phase 1.

[0089] 在屏障初始化后，Producer0 和 Producer1 线程在阶段 0 中等待到达-等待屏障 BarBu-fAvail，因为 DataBuf 已满，没有空间存储来自生产者的更多数据。Consumer0 和 Consumer1 各自读取 DataBuf 的相应缓冲区，并通过调用线程 arrive( ) 函数，每次递增 BarBufAvail 上的到达计数，从而更新 BarBufAvail 屏障，表明 DataBuf 中的部分数据已被消费。当 BarBufAvail 上的到达计数表明所有预期的到达都已收到（即 Acnt=0）时，BarBufAvail 屏障被清除，BarBufAvail 屏障移动到下一阶段——阶段 1。

[0090] The move to phase 1 from phase 0 , sets the phase count of the BarBufAvail barrier to 1 and reinitializes the expected arrive count (i.e. P=1, Anct=-2). Note that the BarDatRdy barrier is still in its phase 0.

[0090] 从阶段0迁移到阶段1会将BarBufAvail屏障的相位计数设置为1，并重新初始化预期到达计数（即 P=1，Anct=-2）。注意，BarDatRdy屏障仍处于其阶段0。

[0091] Since the BarBufAvail barrier is cleared (indicating that buffers are available), the producer threads can proceed. As shown, Producer0 proceeds to call a transaction arrive( ) function, thereafter store data to two DataBuf buffers D0 and D1, and then wait on BarBufAvail. Producer1 proceeds to first store data to two DataBuf buffers D2 and D3, thereafter call a transaction arrive( ) function (or generating an arrive packet by another means, and sending to the synchronization unit), and then wait on BarBufAvail. Each producer thread may wait on BarBufAvail by calling a thread wait( ) indicating the barrier and the current phase.

[0091] 由于 BarBufAvail 屏障已清除（表明缓冲区可用），生产者线程可以继续执行。如图所示，Producer0 继续调用 transaction arrive( ) 函数，之后将数据存储到两个 DataBuf 缓冲区 D0 和 D1，然后等待 BarBufAvail。Producer1 首先将数据存储到两个 DataBuf 缓冲区 D2 和 D3，此后调用 transaction arrive( ) 函数（或通过其他方式生成一个到达包，并发送至同步单元），然后等待 BarBufAvail。每个生产者线程可通过调用 thread wait( ) 来等待 BarBufAvail，并指明屏障和当前阶段。

[0092] Each transaction arrive( ) called by the producer threads, in addition to updating the arrive count "Acnt", also updates the transaction count in the BarDatRdy transaction barrier to indicate how much data (in this example, how many buffers in DataBuf) it will be storing. In this example, such updating is accomplished by decrementing the transaction count "Tcnt": Producer0 and Producer1 each calls a transaction arrive( ) indicating a store of 2 buffers.

[0092] 每个由生产者线程调用的交易 arrive( )，除了更新到达计数“Acnt”之外，还会更新 BarDatRdy 事务屏障中的事务计数，以表示它将存储多少数据（在本例中，即 DataBuf 中有多少个缓冲区）。在本例中，这种更新是通过递减事务计数“Tcnt”来实现的：Producer0 和 Producer1 各自调用了交易 arrive( )，指示存储 2 个缓冲区。

[0093] As illustrated, each store performed by the producer threads to store D0-D3 to DataBuf increments the transaction count (Tcnt) by the number of buffers stored. Thus, it can be seen that the transaction arrive( ) of Producer0 updated Tcnt to -2 indicating that it will be storing two buffers, and that each subsequent store operation incremented Tcnt by 1 so that Tcnt=2 at which point Producer1's transaction arrive( ) decremented Tcnt by the number of buffers written by Producer1. This sequence illustrates that the respective threads can call transaction arrive( ) before or after the corresponding store operations. The arrive( ) operations are called by the threads, and the store operations are transactions that may be performed by hardware units, such as, for example, a DMA copy engine, the TMA unit, etc.

[0093] 如图所示，生产者线程执行的每个将D0-D3存储到DataBuf的存储操作都会将事务计数（Tcnt）增加所存储的缓冲区数量。因此可见，Producer0的transaction arrive( )将Tcnt更新为-2，表明它将存储两个缓冲区，而随后的每个存储操作将Tcnt递增1，使Tcnt=2；此时，Producer1的transaction arrive( )将Tcnt减去Producer1写入的缓冲区数量。此序列说明，各线程可以在相应的存储操作之前或之后调用transaction arrive( )。arrive( )操作由线程调用，而存储操作是可能由硬件单元（例如DMA复制引擎、TMA单元等）执行的事务。

[0094] When, in phase 0, the BarDatRdy transaction barrier arrive count is 0 and the transaction count is 0 (Acnt=0, Tcnt=0) indicating that the expected number of thread arrives have arrived and the expected number of transactions have completed, the BarDatRdy barrier is cleared and moves into phase 1 reinitializing the barrier to \( \mathrm{P} = 0 \) , Acnt \( = - 2 \) , and Tcnt=0.

[0094] 当阶段0中，BarDatRdy 事务屏障到达计数为0且事务计数为0（Acnt=0, Tcnt=0），表明预期数量的线程到达和预期数量的事务已完成，则该 BarDatRdy 屏障被清除并进入阶段1，重新初始化屏障为 \( \mathrm{P} = 0 \) ，Acnt \( = - 2 \) ，Tcnt=0。

[0095] The clearing of BarDatRdy allows any threads waiting on it to proceed. Note that, according to the illustrated scenario, only Producer® is waiting (e.g. has already called transaction wait( )) on BarDatRdy, and Producer1 happens to call transaction wait on BarDatRdy in phase 0 only after BarDatRdy is already cleared in phase 0 . Thus, while Producer0 is initially blocked by BarDatRdy, Producer1 passes through BarDatRdy without blocking because the barrier is already cleared when Producer1 makes its wait( ) call. In either case, after the BarDatRdy barrier phase 0 is cleared and after its respective transaction barrier wait( ) in phase 0 , each consumer thread consumes the data in DataBuf, optionally performs any processing using the data (in this example, HMMA etc.) and calls thread arrive( ) on BarBufAvail which is in phase 1 thereby updating the arrive count in BarBufAvail. The consumer threads then wait on BarDatRdy in phase 1 for data to be available again.

[0095] 清除 BarDatRdy 可让任何等待它的线程继续执行。请注意，根据所示场景，只有 Producer0 在 BarDatRdy 上等待（例如已调用 transaction wait( )），而 Producer1 恰好在阶段 0 的 BarDatRdy 已被清除之后才在阶段 0 调用 transaction wait。这样，虽然 Producer0 最初被 BarDatRdy 阻塞，但由于 Producer1 进行 wait( ) 调用时屏障已经清除，它便无阻塞地通过了 BarDatRdy。无论哪种情况，在 BarDatRdy 屏障的阶段 0 被清除、且各自在阶段 0 执行完 transaction barrier wait( ) 之后，每个消费者线程都会消费 DataBuf 中的数据，可选地使用这些数据执行一些处理（本例中为 HMMA 等），并对处于阶段 1 的 BarBufAvail 调用 thread arrive( )，从而更新 BarBufAvail 中的到达计数。接着，消费者线程在阶段 1 等待 BarDatRdy，以便数据再次可用。

[0096] When BarBufAvail is phase \( 1\left( {\mathrm{P} = 1}\right) \) and Acnt reaches 0, it is cleared (and reinitialized to phase 0 and initial expected arrive count; \( \mathrm{P} = 0 \) and Acnt \( = - 2 \) ) and Producer 0 and Producer1 waiting on it are allowed to proceed. The producer threads, now operating while the BarBufAvail barrier is in phase 0, each calls transaction arrive( ) on BarDatRdy indicating the number of buffers (in this example, 2) that each expects to store. Although further interactions are not illustrated, it will be understood that the producer threads and consumer threads can interact to safely use the data in the buffer.

[0096] 当BarBufAvail处于阶段\( 1\left( {\mathrm{P} = 1}\right) \)且Acnt达到0时，它被清除（并被重新初始化为阶段0与初始预期到达计数；\( \mathrm{P} = 0 \) 且 Acnt \( = - 2 \)），同时等待它的Producer 0和Producer1被允许继续执行。现在，生产者线程在BarBufAvail屏障处于阶段0时运行，每个线程都在BarDatRdy上调用transaction arrive()，指明各自预期存储的缓冲区数量（在本例中为2）。尽管未展示进一步的交互，但可以理解，生产者线程和消费者线程能够进行交互，以安全地使用缓冲区中的数据。

[0097] Transaction barriers may use phase toggle (i.e., indicating phase0 or phase 1 by toggling the phase counter attribute of the transaction barrier between 0 and 1) to indicate barrier clear. In some embodiments, to make it easier for software to track the phase, the arrive( ) operation will return the old phase to be used in a wait( ) operation. This works well for traditional bulk-sync scenario in which each thread will do the arrive first and the wait later. However for producer-consumer scenarios, the phase returned by arrive( ) could be useless if it was done in producer that does not call a wait( ) (the hardware design is flexible on who does the arrive( )). And on the other hand, wait( ) on consumer side still may require a phase to correctly operate.

[0097] 事务屏障可以使用相位切换（即，通过在 0 和 1 之间切换事务屏障的相位计数器属性来指示 phase0 或 phase1）来表示屏障清除。在一些实施例中，为了使软件更容易跟踪相位，arrive( ) 操作将返回旧相位，以便在 wait( ) 操作中使用。这对于传统的批量同步场景非常有效，在该场景中，每个线程将先执行 arrive( )，然后再执行 wait( )。然而，对于生产者-消费者场景，如果 arrive( ) 由不调用 wait( ) 的生产者执行，则返回的相位可能是无用的（硬件设计对由谁来执行 arrive( ) 是灵活的）。另一方面，消费者端的 wait( ) 仍然可能需要一个相位才能正确操作。

[0098] FIG. 6B shows an interaction identical to that of FIG. 6A, except that the transaction arrive( ) is issued by each of the consumer threads in between their respective barrier arrive( ) and barrier wait( ) calls made by each of them. Thus, FIG. 6B may be described as an example producer-consumer interaction where the consumer threads control the transaction barrier since the transaction arrive( ) is issued by the consumer threads in contrast to FIG. 6A where the transaction arrive( ) is issued by the producer threads. In the illustrates examples, control of the transaction barrier by the consumer may be more efficient since the barrier is local to the consumer.

[0098] 图6B展示了一个与图6A相同的交互过程，不同之处在于每个消费者线程均在其各自的barrier arrive()与barrier wait()调用之间发出了transaction arrive()调用。因此，图6B可被描述为一个生产者-消费者交互的示例，其中消费者线程控制着事务屏障，因为transaction arrive()是由消费者线程发出的，这与图6A中transaction arrive()由生产者线程发出的情况相反。在所示示例中，由消费者控制事务屏障可能更为高效，因为该屏障对于消费者而言是本地的。

[0099] Note that in the interactions shown in FIGS. 6A and 6B, the arrive events of threads and transactions both contribute to the clearing of the transaction barrier by incrementing the arrive count, but the transaction arrive also sets the expected transaction count. Since hardware transactions such as, for example, data movement by copy engines, TMA unit operations to move data blocks or multicast data etc., are typically not constrained to wait on other resources, in some embodiments, the programming model may not permit a hardware unit (e.g., such as a copy engine, TMA unit etc.) to utilize the barrier to wait for a resource (e.g., buffers to store data), and may rely on the threads to ensure the availability of the resource before a hardware unit is invoked to use the resource.

[0099] 注意，在图6A和6B所示的交互中，线程和事务的到达事件都通过递增到达计数值来促成事务屏障的解除，但事务到达同时会设置预期事务计数。由于诸如复制引擎执行的数据移动、用于移动数据块或多播数据等的TMA单元操作这类硬件事务，通常不受等待其他资源的限制，因此在某些实施例中，编程模型可能不允许硬件单元（例如，复制引擎、TMA单元等）利用屏障来等待资源（例如，用于存储数据的缓冲区），而可能依赖线程在调用硬件单元使用该资源之前确保资源的可用性。

docs.title: Hardware-Implemented Synchronization Unit
docs.text:
[0100] FIG. 7 schematically illustrates an example synchronization unit, also referred to herein sometimes as a "SYNCS" unit, that is implemented as a hardware circuit in accordance with some embodiments. In some embodiments, the synchronization unit 700 provides hardware acceleration to the transaction barrier 500. For example, some or all operations that are required for the creation and maintenance of a transaction barrier 500 in a shared memory 722 can be accelerated by hardware in the form of the synchronization unit 700.

[0100] 图7示意性地展示了一个示例同步单元，在本文中有时也称作“SYNCS”单元，根据一些实施例，其被实现为硬件电路。在一些实施例中，同步单元700为事务屏障500提供硬件加速。例如，在共享内存722中创建和维护事务屏障500所需的部分或全部操作，可由同步单元700形式的硬件加以加速。

[0101] The synchronization unit 700 includes a barrier datapath circuit 702. A barrier cache 704 attached to the datapath circuit 702 is configured to store cached versions of a plurality of transaction barriers 500 that are stored in shared memory 722 that is communicatively connected to the cache 704 via an interface 720. The barrier cache 704, in a non-limiting embodiment, has four 257-bit cache lines, and is a fully associative non-coherent cache. Although memory 722 connected to interface 720 is shared memory in the illustrated example, the memory can be or may include another memory such as, for example, another cache memory, linear memory, distributed or non-distributed shared memory, or global memory, in some other embodiments of this disclosure.

[0101] 同步单元700包括屏障数据通路电路702。与该数据通路电路702连接的屏障缓存704，被配置为存储多个事务屏障500的缓存副本，这些事务屏障存储在共享内存722中，该共享内存通过接口720与缓存704通信连接。在一个非限制性实施例中，屏障缓存704具有四条257位缓存行，并且是一个全关联非一致性缓存。尽管在所示示例中连接至接口720的内存722是共享内存，但在本公开的一些其他实施例中，该内存可以是或可以包括其他内存，例如另一缓存内存、线性内存、分布式或非分布式共享内存，或全局内存。

[0102] In an embodiment, each entry in barrier cache 704 includes a tag which has a value that is derived from the memory address (e.g. address in the shared memory backing store) of the barrier stored in the entry. Each entry may also include one or more valid bits. When a thread arrive or transaction update operation is received, the barrier datapath 702 performs a tag check in barrier cache 704 to determine whether the associated barrier is in the barrier cache 704. If the associated barrier is in the barrier cache 704 (i.e., a cache hit occurs), the arrive and/or transaction counts of the barrier in the barrier cache 704 is updated. If the associated barrier is not in the barrier cache 704 (i.e., a cache miss occurs), the barrier is read from the backing memory and written to the barrier cache 704. If the barrier cache 704 is full, an entry can be evicted by writing the associated barrier to backing memory. When a barrier is evicted from the barrier cache 704, some cached information, such as, for example, information as to what threads are waiting on that barrier, may be discarded.

[0102] 在一个实施例中，屏障缓存704中的每个条目包含一个标签，该标签的值源自该条目所存屏障的内存地址（例如，共享内存后备存储中的地址）。每个条目还可能包含一个或多个有效位。当接收到线程到达或事务更新操作时，屏障数据通路702会在屏障缓存704中执行标签检查，以确定关联的屏障是否在屏障缓存704中。如果关联的屏障在屏障缓存704中（即发生缓存命中），则更新屏障缓存704中该屏障的到达计数和/或事务计数。如果关联的屏障不在屏障缓存704中（即发生缓存未命中），则从后备内存中读取屏障并写入屏障缓存704。如果屏障缓存704已满，可以通过将关联的屏障写入后备内存来逐出一个条目。当屏障从屏障缓存704中被逐出时，某些缓存信息，例如关于哪些线程正在等待该屏障的信息，可能会被丢弃。

[0103] In some example embodiments, the barrier cache is a write-back cache which is non-coherent with the shared memory back storage. Thus, at times, the cached barrier, or more specifically the cached barrier data structure stored in the cache 704, may contain state different from the shadowed copy backed in shared memory. In example embodiments, it may be the software's responsibility to avoid mixing of barrier operations based on the potentially different states stored in the cache 704 and shared memory operations to the same barrier address without explicit coherency and ordering operation in order to avoid unpredictable results. In other embodiments, hardware is used to prevent such mixing of barrier operations.

[0103] 在一些示例实施例中，屏障缓存是一个写回缓存，与共享内存后备存储不一致。因此，缓存中的屏障，或更具体地说，存储在缓存704中的缓存屏障数据结构，有时可能包含与共享内存中备份的影子副本不同的状态。在示例实施例中，软件有责任避免混合基于缓存704中存储的可能不同状态的屏障操作和对同一屏障地址的共享内存操作，除非进行显式的一致性和排序操作，以避免不可预测的结果。在其他实施例中，使用硬件来防止这种屏障操作的混合。

[0104] The synchronization unit may be configured to trigger a flash-clean of the barrier cache upon CTA-exit, and thereby ensure that no stale lines from previous CTAs can exist in the barrier cache when a new CTA is launched recycling those used memory spaces. As a result, software may not be required to concern itself about dirty lines from previous CTAs corrupting useful data upon cache eviction. However, the tag can remain valid in the cache which means that software may need to follow coherency rules at the very beginning of the CTA launch. In some embodiments, the synchronization unit may trigger a barrier cache write-back at a selected time to free the users from being responsible on the silent data corruption prevention. In some embodiments, the barrier cache 704 supports an invalidate operation which clears the valid bit of a matching cache entry. This operation can be issued by a thread or initiated on a CTA launch. In some embodiments hardware-based cache coherence measures such as monitoring load and store operations to the memory, clearing the valid bit in response to matching stores, and/or updating the entry in response to matching stores, and/or supplying data to matching loads may be implemented.

[0104] 该同步单元可配置为在CTA退出时触发屏障缓存的快速清理，从而确保当新CTA启动并回收那些已用内存空间时，屏障缓存中不会残留来自先前CTA的过时行。因此，软件可能无需担心先前CTA的脏行在缓存逐出时破坏有用数据。然而，标签可能在缓存中保持有效，这意味着软件可能需要在CTA启动伊始遵循一致性规则。在某些实施例中，同步单元可在选定时刻触发屏障缓存写回，以使用户无需负责静默数据损坏的预防。在某些实施例中，屏障缓存704支持无效化操作，该操作会清除匹配缓存条目的有效位。此操作可由线程发出，或在CTA启动时发起。在某些实施例中，可实现基于硬件的缓存一致性措施，例如监视对内存的加载和存储操作、响应匹配存储清除有效位，和/或响应匹配存储更新条目，和/或向匹配加载提供数据。

[0105] The barrier datapath circuit 702 may include hardware circuitry to perform operations such as updating one or more attributes such as arrival count, transaction count, phase count, lock, etc., and/or the resetting/reinitializing of cached transaction barrier objects 500 that may be in the cache 704 with a shadow copy stored in memory 722. In some embodiments, the datapath circuit 702 may be able to perform all updates on a transaction barrier 500 in response for a thread arrive( ), thread wait( ), transaction arrive( ) or a transaction such as a data store operation at the rate, for example, of 1 barrier operation per clock per SM. The datapath circuit 702 may, through one or more interfaces 716, signal other hardware units (e.g., scoreboard, CBU, etc.) to perform operations such as scoreboard release, register file update, predicate write-back, and CBU wake up. [0106] In some embodiments, the datapath circuit 702 is connected to a buffer 706 that is sometimes referred to herein as a "try-wait buffer" or "try-wait rendezvous buffer".

[0105] 屏障数据路径电路 702 可包含硬件电路，用以执行诸如更新一个或多个属性（例如到达计数、事务计数、阶段计数、锁等）的操作，和/或利用存储在存储器 722 中的影子副本重置/重新初始化缓存 704 中可能存在的事务屏障对象 500。在一些实施例中，数据路径电路 702 可以能够对事务屏障 500 执行所有更新，以响应线程 arrive( )、线程 wait( )、事务 arrive( ) 或诸如数据存储操作的事务，例如以每 SM 每时钟 1 次屏障操作的速率。数据路径电路 702 可通过一个或多个接口 716 向其他硬件单元（例如记分板、CBU 等）发出信号，以执行诸如记分板释放、寄存器文件更新、谓词写回和 CBU 唤醒等操作。[0106] 在一些实施例中，数据路径电路 702 连接到一个缓冲区 706，该缓冲区在本文中有时称为“try-wait buffer”或“try-wait rendezvous buffer”。

The buffer 706 is configured to store information regarding one or more threads that are waiting on any of the transaction barriers. In an example embodiment, upon a thread calling thread wait( ) on a transaction barrier that is not yet cleared, that thread will be added to the try-wait buffer 706 by the datapath circuit 702 over connection 718. In some embodiments, the try-wait buffer can store 32 entries with each entry corresponding to information regarding a respective waiting thread. The buffer 706 may be a content addressable memory (CAM) storing the information regarding the one or more threads. The CAM may be accessible based on the transaction barrier address and/or thread identifier.

缓冲器706被配置为存储关于一个或多个正等待任何事务屏障的线程的信息。在示例实施例中，当某个线程在一个尚未清除的事务屏障上调用thread wait( )时，该线程将由数据通路电路702通过连接718添加到尝试等待缓冲器706中。在一些实施例中，try-wait缓冲器能够存储32个条目，每个条目对应于一个相应等待线程的信息。缓冲器706可以是存储关于所述一个或多个线程的信息的内容可寻址存储器(CAM)。所述CAM可以基于事务屏障地址和/或线程标识符进行访问。

[0107] When a transaction barrier 500 in the cache 704 clears, the datapath circuit 702 notifies all threads waiting (i.e. blocked) on that transaction barrier 500 in the try-wait buffer 706. These threads may be executing on the same SM, or on different SMs, or on both the same SM and different SMs. Upon being notified, the waiting threads may each reissue the thread wait( ) and, the barrier having already been cleared, proceed in its execution. In some embodiments, the waiting threads may, when notified, proceed to continuing with their respective executions without reissuing the thread wait( ). In some embodiments, the try-wait buffer may include, or may be associated with, a timer to clock timeout of respective waiting threads. A decoupled approach to timer tick evaluation and retry may be used. The tick loop picks up timeout entries from buffer to retry, whereas the retry loop could be triggered by either timeout or a barrier clear. This may be considered a lazy retry mode which only has timeout entries to retry when retry is triggered by timeout.

[0107] 当缓存704中的事务屏障500清除时，数据通路电路702会通知try-wait缓冲器706中所有在该事务屏障500上等待（即阻塞）的线程。这些线程可能在同一SM上执行，也可能在不同SM上执行，或者同时在同一SM和不同SM上执行。收到通知后，等待线程可能会各自重新发出thread wait( )，并且由于屏障已经清除，继续执行。在一些实施例中，等待线程在收到通知时可能继续各自执行，而无需重新发出thread wait( )。在一些实施例中，try-wait缓冲器可以包含或关联一个计时器，以记录各自等待线程的超时。可采用解耦的方式来进行计时器滴答评估和重试。滴答循环从缓冲器中提取超时条目进行重试，而重试循环可能由超时或屏障清除触发。这可视为一种惰性重试模式，仅当重试由超时触发时，才以超时条目进行重试。

[0108] In some embodiments, CBU integration is made to make the synchronization unit's wait( ) operation efficient in the presence of divergence. The idea is to let the synchronization unit handle convergent waiting through a scoreboard, while letting the CBU handle divergence waiting. The same CBU interaction mechanism may also be used in convergent cases to handle corner case sync failure like try-wait buffer being full.

[0108] 在一些实施例中，集成 CBU 是为了让同步单元的 wait( ) 操作在出现发散时更高效。其思想是，让同步单元通过记分板处理收敛等待，同时让 CBU 处理发散等待。同样的 CBU 交互机制也可用于收敛情况中，以处理诸如尝试等待缓冲区已满等边界情况下的同步失败。

[0109] By enabling, in the manner described, for waiting threads to be stored in a buffer that is closely coupled to the datapath circuit, and providing for notification of barrier clears to the threads stored in the buffer, the synchronization unit enables the elimination or at least a drastic reduction in the overhead associated with the retry loop typically associated with threads waiting on a barrier.

[0109] 通过以上述方式使等待线程存储在与数据通路电路紧密耦合的缓冲区中，并向缓冲区中的线程提供屏障清除通知，该同步单元能够消除或至少大幅减少通常伴随等待屏障的线程的重试循环所带来的开销。

[0110] The transaction barrier will track the number of transactions in addition to the arrives to match an expectation before declaring barrier clear. The transaction traffic can be high and may steal a substantial amount of memory input/output bandwidth. Therefore, the synchronization unit also includes a coalescing circuit that coalesces the transactions update to minimize the bandwidth tax. The synchronization unit 700 may further include a multiplexer circuit 708 that serializes instructions and commands that are incoming to the barrier datapath circuit 702 from the try-wait buffer 706, arriving load/store transactions (e.g., LDG-STBAR) operations 714, remote arrivals, and transaction updates received over GNIC via a coalescer circuit 712 and SYNCS.{OP}Inst via a coalescing and serializing circuit 710. Coalescer circuit 712 may, in some embodiments, coalesce multiple instructions to the same transaction barrier into one instruction. Arrives and transactions that come from other SMs either by themselves or as part of stores (STAs). Both local and remote TMA unit loads may appear to be STAs from the synchronization unit point of view.

[0110] 事务屏障除了跟踪到达次数外，还会跟踪事务数量，以满足预期条件后才宣布屏障清除。事务流量可能很高，并可能占用大量内存输入/输出带宽。因此，同步单元还包含一个合并电路，用于合并事务更新以最小化带宽开销。同步单元700可进一步包括多路复用器电路708，该电路对输入到屏障数据路径电路702的指令和命令进行串行化处理，这些指令和命令来自尝试等待缓冲区706、到达的加载/存储事务（例如，LDG-STBAR）操作714、远程到达，以及通过合并器电路712经由GNIC接收的事务更新和通过合并与串行化电路710接收的SYNCS.{OP}指令。在某些实施例中，合并器电路712可将面向同一事务屏障的多条指令合并为一条指令。到达和事务可能来自其他SM，无论是以独立形式还是作为存储操作（STA）的一部分。从同步单元的角度来看，本地和远程TMA单元加载都可能表现为STA。

[0111] The barrier cache serves as a traffic filter to memory back-store since the barrier traffic can be intensive. In example embodiments, only barrier cache miss and eviction traffic are made visible to memory (such as the shared memory in the example). The wait( ) operation on a non-cleared barrier will result in an insertion operation to the try-wait buffer, and optionally trigger eviction and failure return. In example embodiments, the respective instruction set architecture to define if the try-wait buffer is retry based (loop between tracker and datapath circuit), bar-clear trigger based (the try-wait buffer tracker being a CAM waiting for output from datapath circuit) or even mixed (imprecise wakeup trigger retry loop).

[0111] 屏障缓存可充当流向内存后备存储的流量过滤器，因为屏障流量可能很大。在示例实施例中，只有屏障缓存未命中和逐出流量才对内存（如示例中的共享内存）可见。在未清除的屏障上执行 wait() 操作会导致向尝试等待缓冲区插入一项操作，并可选择性地触发逐出和失败返回。在示例实施例中，各自的指令集架构定义了尝试等待缓冲区是基于重试（追踪器与数据路径电路之间的循环）、基于屏障清除触发（尝试等待缓冲区追踪器是一个 CAM，等待数据路径电路的输出）还是混合型（不精确的唤醒触发重试循环）。

[0112] The synchronization unit 700 is not limited to providing hardware acceleration to transaction barriers. For example, in some embodiments, the synchronization unit 700 may provide hardware acceleration to arrive-wait barriers by, for example, caching the arrive-wait barriers in the barrier cache, providing the datapath circuit for processing arrive( ) and wait( ) on the arrive-wait barriers, and by providing for the threads waiting on the arrive-wait barrier to utilize the try-wait barrier. In an example embodiment, the producer will perform a sequence wait(barrier0)=>data store=>fence( )=>arrive(barrier1), while the consumer will perform the sequence arrive(barrier0)=>other operations=>wait(barrier1)=>consume stored data, in which at least the wait( ) may use the try-wait buffer thereby reducing the polling of the barrier 1 is reduced.

[0112] 同步单元700不限于为事务屏障提供硬件加速。例如，在某些实施例中，同步单元700可通过以下方式为到达-等待屏障提供硬件加速：将到达-等待屏障缓存在屏障缓存中，提供数据通路电路以处理到达-等待屏障上的arrive( )与wait( )操作，并为在到达-等待屏障上等待的线程提供利用尝试等待屏障的能力。在一个示例性实施例中，生产者将执行序列wait(barrier0)=>数据存储=>fence( )=>arrive(barrier1)，而消费者将执行序列arrive(barrier0)=>其他操作=>wait(barrier1)=>消费所存储的数据，其中至少wait( )可利用尝试等待缓存，从而减少对屏障1的轮询操作。

[0113] FIG. 8 is a block diagram of an example nonlimiting memory-backed implementation of the FIG. 5 transaction barrier 500 with hardware-acceleration by the synchronization unit 700. As discussed above, barrier instructions such as instructions for transaction barrier creation, transaction arrive( ) function, transaction barrier wait( ) function, etc. (see, e.g., SYNCS.{OP} inst etc. received through coalescing and serializing circuit 710 in FIG. 7) can be performed by the barrier datapath circuitry 702 on the cached version, resident in the barrier cache 704, of the transaction barrier 500 that is stored in a memory such as, for example, shared memory 722.

[0113] 图8是一个示例性非限制性的、由同步单元700进行硬件加速的图5事务屏障500的基于内存实现的框图。如上文所讨论的，屏障指令，例如用于事务屏障创建、事务 arrive( ) 函数、事务屏障 wait( ) 函数等的指令（参见例如通过图7中的合并与串行化电路710接收的 SYNCS.{OP} inst 等），可以由屏障数据通路电路702对存储在内存（例如，共享内存722）中的事务屏障500的缓存版本（驻留在屏障缓存704中）执行。

[0114] The phase counter 812, arrive counter 814, expected number of arrivals 808 and the transaction counter 810 are stored in the cache 704 as attributes of the cached transaction barrier 500, and are accessible by the datapath circuit 702 which in example embodiments is able to perform operations to change the value of attributes of the transaction barrier 500 in the cache 704. The datapath circuit operates on serialized instructions, and thus can operate on the transaction barrier without additional protections. The datapath circuit can modify the arrive counter 814 and transaction counter 810. The arrive counter is incremented in response to thread arrives and transaction arrives. The transaction counter 810 is decremented when an expected transaction count is provided by a transaction arrive and is incremented responsive to transaction arrive messages or other hardware unit generated messages informing of a transaction count. The datapath circuit also can reset the synchronization primitive 500 if the modifying causes the arrival counter decoder 806 (which functions as a comparator that compares the counts of the arrive counter 814 and transaction counter 810 with predetermined values (e.g., 0) and resets the counters and the phase indicator based on results of the comparison) to determine that no more threads or transactions are awaited before the transaction barrier can reset. In such instance, the decoder 806 initiates a hardware-controlled reset of the transaction barrier 500 instance to "flip" the phase indicator 812, reload the expected number of arrives 808 into the arrive counter 814, and reset the transaction count 810 to an initializing value (e.g., 0). In some embodiments, the transaction barrier 500 may include an expected transaction count as another attribute. The expected transaction count attribute, in such embodiments, specifies an initial number of transactions with which the transaction counter 810 is initialized in each phase.

[0114] 相位计数器812、到达计数器814、预期到达数808和事务计数器810作为缓存事务屏障500的属性存储在缓存704中，数据通路电路702可对其进行访问。在示例实施例中，该数据通路电路能够执行操作来改变缓存704中事务屏障500的属性值。数据通路电路基于串行化的指令运行，因此无需额外的保护即可对事务屏障进行操作。数据通路电路可修改到达计数器814和事务计数器810。到达计数器会在线程到达和事务到达时递增。当事务到达提供预期事务计数时，事务计数器810递减；当收到事务到达消息或其他硬件单元生成的、通知事务计数的消息时，事务计数器810递增。如果修改操作导致到达计数器解码器806（其功能相当于一个比较器，将到达计数器814和事务计数器810的计数值与预定值（例如0）进行比较，并根据比较结果重置计数器及相位指示符）判定在事务屏障能够重置之前不再需要等待任何线程或事务，则数据通路电路还可以重置同步原语500。在这种情况下，解码器806会启动对事务屏障500实例的硬件控制重置，以“翻转”相位指示符812，将预期到达数808重新加载到到达计数器814中，并将事务计数810重置为初始值（例如0）。在一些实施例中，事务屏障500可能包含预期事务计数作为另一属性。在此类实施例中，预期事务计数属性规定了事务计数器810在每个阶段初始化时所置的初始事务数量。

[0115] In example non-limiting embodiments, the processor architecture may be modified to provide additional circuitry that ties hardware-based processes such as DMA, TMA unit, Multicast and other hardware units that provide data movement etc., into the synchronization barrier implementation in the synchronization unit 700. Each of such hardware units may be configured to, associated with each store operation, transmit an update message to the synchronization unit 700 indicating the transaction barrier address and the transaction count associated with the store operation (e.g., number of bytes written by the store operation). The thread that makes the call to the hardware unit to cause the store operation may provide the hardware unit with the barrier address. The synchronization unit 700, or more particularly the coalescing units 710 and/or 712, may coalesce update messages to the same barrier and synthesize one or more instructions that are then provided to the datapath circuit 702 through the multiplexer 708. The TMA unit, for example, may generate and transmit such messages to the synchronization unit 700 for each data store operation completed. In another example, the synchronization unit 700 at the multiplexor 708 receives instructions such as ARRIVES.LDGSTSBAR from a DMA/copy engine signaling that all DMA transfers from a particular thread have completed, and updates the arrival count and/or the transaction count in the transaction barrier accordingly. The instruction may cause the datapath circuit to process an arrive (see FIG. 9B) in which one of the input parameters include the transaction count specified by the hardware unit.

在示例非限制性实施例中，处理器架构可被修改以提供额外电路，将基于硬件的过程，如DMA、TMA单元、多播及提供数据移动等的其他硬件单元，连接到同步单元700中的同步屏障实现。每个此类硬件单元可被配置为，针对每个存储操作，向同步单元700发送更新消息，指示该存储操作关联的事务屏障地址和事务计数（例如，该存储操作写入的字节数）。调用硬件单元以引发存储操作的线程可向该硬件单元提供屏障地址。同步单元700，或更具体地，合并单元710和/或712，可合并发往同一屏障的更新消息，并合成一条或多条指令，随后通过多路复用器708提供给数据路径电路702。例如，TMA单元可为每个已完成的数据存储操作生成并发送此类消息至同步单元700。在另一示例中，同步单元700在多路复用器708处接收来自DMA/复制引擎的指令，如ARRIVES.LDGSTSBAR，表示特定线程的所有DMA传输已完成，并相应地更新事务屏障中的到达计数和/或事务计数。该指令可使数据路径电路处理一次到达（见图9B），其中输入参数之一包括由该硬件单元指定的事务计数。

docs.title: Example Instruction Set Architecture Implementation
docs.text:
[0116] Example non-limiting embodiments herein implement an Instruction Set Architecture (ISA) to include instructions for accessing the new transaction barrier synchronization primitive. In example non-limiting implementations, as with the arrive-wait barrier, a thread will typically include two different primitive calls: an "arrive" primitive call to the barrier, and a "wait" primitive call to the barrier. Between those two calls, as described above and shown in FIGS. 6A and 6B, the thread may include instructions unrelated to the barrier that can be executed without violating the barrier.

[0116] 本文的示例性非限制性实施例实现了一种指令集架构（ISA），其中包括用于访问新的事务屏障同步原语的指令。在示例性非限制性实现中，与到达-等待屏障一样，一个线程通常会包含两个不同的原语调用：对屏障的“到达”原语调用，和对屏障的“等待”原语调用。在这两次调用之间，如上所述并在图6A和图6B中所示，线程可以包含与屏障无关的指令，这些指令可以在不违反该屏障的情况下执行。

[0117] As described above various embodiments may utilize the transaction barrier 500 with or without hardware-acceleration provided by the synchronization units. Accordingly, in some embodiments, during initialization, the system will initially set up the synchronization barrier instance in memory (e.g., shared memory or global memory) and store the appropriate data there that the system needs to retain in order to implement the barrier (e.g., updating of arrive count, transaction count, phase count, expected arrive count, lock). Typically, a SDK (software development kit) provided by the system designer may include a library including these various function calls to initiate a synchronization barrier. Similarly, the ISA of the processing system may include instructions for the transaction barrier create(), the transaction barrier arrive( ) and transaction barrier wait( ). Atomic operations (stored in a processor instruction register and decoded by an instruction decoder) such as arithmetic functions (such as atomicAdd(), atomicSub(), atom-icExch( ), atomicMin( ), atomicMax( ), atomicInc( ), atomicDec( ), atomicCAS( )), bitwise functions (such as atomicAnd( ), atomicOr( ), atomicXor( )), and other functions allow a SM to change the value of the transaction barrier 500 "in place" in the memory.

[0117] 如上所述，各种实施例可利用事务屏障500，无论是否由同步单元提供硬件加速。因此，在一些实施例中，在初始化期间，系统将首先在内存（例如，共享内存或全局内存）中设置同步屏障实例，并存储系统为实施该屏障所需保留的适当数据（例如，更新到达计数、事务计数、阶段计数、预期到达计数、锁）。通常，系统设计者提供的SDK（软件开发工具包）可包含一个库，该库包含用于启动同步屏障的各种函数调用。类似地，处理系统的ISA可包含用于事务屏障create()、事务屏障arrive()和事务屏障wait()的指令。原子操作（存储在处理器指令寄存器中并由指令译码器译码），例如算术函数（如atomicAdd()、atomicSub()、atom-icExch()、atomicMin()、atomicMax()、atomicInc()、atomicDec()、atomicCAS()）、位操作函数（如atomicAnd()、atomicOr()、atomicXor()）及其他函数，允许SM在内存中“原地”更改事务屏障500的值。

[0118] One or more additional functions too may be provided for managing the transaction barriers. For example, some embodiments may include a_dropthread function that permanently removes a thread from an transaction barrier (such as when a thread exits), an_addonce function that adds to the count of an transaction barrier by a specific amount, and a_droponce function that reduces the count of an transaction barrier by a specific amount. These may be similar to the corresponding functions described in U.S. Ser. No. 16/712,236 (which is already incorporated by reference).

[0118] 还可以提供一个或多个附加功能来管理事务屏障。例如，一些实施例可能包括一个 a_dropthread 函数（用于在线程退出时永久将该线程从事务屏障中移除）、一个 an_addonce 函数（用于按指定数量增加事务屏障的计数）以及一个 a_droponce 函数（用于按指定数量减少事务屏障的计数）。这些函数可能与 U.S. Ser. No. 16/712,236（该专利已通过引用并入本文）中描述的相应函数相似。

[0119] In some other example non-limiting embodiments, in which transaction barrier operations are accelerated by a synchronization unit 700, one or more of the transaction barrier create(), transaction barrier arrive() and transaction barrier wait( ) (and possibly other defined transaction barrier functions) cause the synchronization circuit to operate on the synchronization barrier 500 in the barrier cache 704. In one example non-limiting embodiment, the following software functions may be used to manage an transaction barrier 500 instance stored in the barrier cache 704:

[0119] 在一些其他示例性非限制性实施例中，其中事务屏障操作由同步单元700加速，事务屏障create()、事务屏障arrive()和事务屏障wait()（以及可能定义的其他事务屏障函数）中的一个或多个使同步电路对屏障缓存704中的同步屏障500进行操作。在一个示例性非限制性实施例中，以下软件函数可用来管理存储在屏障缓存704中的事务屏障500实例：

[0120] a create() function 900 (see FIG. 9A) is used to setup an transaction barrier;

[0120] 使用create()函数900（参见图9A）来设置事务屏障；

[0121] an arrive( ) function 920 (see FIG. 9B) is used by a thread to indicate its arrival at an transaction barrier, and the barrier phase may be returned by this function for use in the wait( ) function; and

[0121] 线程使用 arrive() 函数 920（参见图 9B）来指示其到达事务屏障，并且该函数可能返回屏障阶段以供 wait() 函数使用；并且

[0122] a wait( ) function 950 (see FIG. 9C) is used to wait for an transaction barrier to clear for the specified phase.

[0122] 使用wait( )函数950(参见图9C)来等待指定阶段的事务屏障被清除。

[0123] Both the memory order semantics associated with the arrive-wait barrier and new object fence semantics may be relevant to the synchronization unit in some example embodiments. In the arrive-wait barrier, an arrive( ) and a wait() are used to provide a split barrier where a memory model release and acquire are separated. A split barrier can be described as for an instruction sequence of "

=> arrive(barrier)=>=>wait(barrier)


[0123] 在与到达-等待屏障相关的内存顺序语义和新对象围栏语义中，二者在某些示例实施例中可能与同步单元都有关系。在到达-等待屏障中，使用 arrive() 和 wait() 来提供一种分割屏障，其中内存模型的释放和获取被分离。分割屏障可描述为对于指令序列“
=> arrive(barrier)=>=>wait(barrier)”。


=>": a thread's
load/stores are guaranteed visible to other participating thread'sload/stores; a thread'sload/stores are guaranteed not visible to other participating thread's
load/stores; and a thread's load/stores have no visibility guarantee ordering to other threads (at least not any visibility guarantees provided by this particular barrier).


=> : 一个线程的
加载/存储对其他参与线程的加载/存储保证可见；一个线程的加载/存储对其他参与线程的
加载/存储保证不可见；而一个线程的加载/存储对其他线程没有可见性保证排序（至少不是由该特定屏障提供的任何可见性保证）。


[0124] The arrive(barrier) and wait(barrier) have memory model release and acquire semantics respectively. In some implementations, the atomic arrive (e.g., ATOM.ARRIVE) instruction does not have guaranteed ordering with 
 load/store and requires a memory barrier (e.g., MEMBAR) instruction to guarantee that ordering. This is unlike some hardware named barrier (e.g., BAR. SYNC) instructions in which the implementation has a built in ordering guarantee and does not require an explicit additional memory barrier instruction.


[0124] arrive(barrier) 和 wait(barrier) 分别具有内存模型的 release 和 acquire 语义。在一些实现中，原子 arrive（例如 ATOM.ARRIVE）指令不保证与 
 load/store 的排序，需要一个内存屏障（例如 MEMBAR）指令来保证该排序。这与一些名为 barrier 的硬件指令（例如 BAR. SYNC）不同，在这些指令中，实现具有内置的排序保证，并且不需要显式的额外内存屏障指令。


[0125] With respect to the transaction barrier, the instructions used to implement the arrive(barrier) and wait(barrier) functions of a split barrier, when used together do provide an ordering guarantee of 
load/store for thread synchronization at CTA scope without needing an explicit additional memory barrier instruction. Synchronization at greater then CTA scope may, however, require an additional memory barrier.


[0125] 关于事务屏障，用于实现分割屏障的 arrive(barrier) 和 wait(barrier) 函数的指令，当一起使用时，确实在 CTA 范围内为线程同步提供了 
加载/存储
 的顺序保证，而无需显式的额外内存屏障指令。然而，在大于 CTA 范围的同步中，可能需要额外的内存屏障。



[0126] For the transaction barrier, in some embodiments, the transaction(barrier) operation carried by a single data transaction follows the object fence semantics. Object fence semantics means that only the load/store for that transaction has guaranteed visibility (ordered before the corresponding transaction update to the barrier), and no other visibility ordering is guaranteed. At the implementation level, this object fence ordering guarantee may be provided without needing any explicit additional memory barrier instructions. [0127] ACTA-wide fence is used in some embodiments to order instructions for the transaction barrier. This enables a single fence to orders the entire SM, instead of each thread injecting its own fence. The CTA-wide fence can be generated by synchronization unit hardware at the clearing of a transaction barrier.



[0126] 对于事务屏障，在某些实施例中，单个数据事务携带的事务（屏障）操作遵循对象栅栏语义。对象栅栏语义意味着仅该事务的加载/存储具有有保证的可见性（在屏障对应的更新之前排序完成），而其他可见性排序则不予保证。在实现层面，这种对象栅栏排序保证可能无需任何显式的额外内存屏障指令即可提供。[0127] 在某些实施例中使用ACTA范围栅栏来为事务屏障排序指令。这使得单个栅栏便能对整个SM进行排序，而非每个线程注入自己的栅栏。CTA范围栅栏可由同步单元硬件在事务屏障清除时生成。



[0128] The synchronization unit hardware may generate a flushing operation in order to guarantee visibility of all previous issued transaction barrier instructions before any following load/store or transaction instructions. A thread-wise memory barrier may be used for this purpose together with the flushing operation to extend the visibility beyond the flushing point. In some embodiments, a scoreboard is used to serve the purpose of the flushing operation. All transaction barrier instructions can release write scoreboards, including those that do not write back any results.



[0128] 同步单元硬件可生成冲刷操作，以确保所有先前发出的事务屏障指令在后续任何加载/存储或事务指令执行前对系统的可见性。线程级内存屏障可与该冲刷操作协同使用，从而将可见性范围扩展至冲刷点之外。在某些实施例中，采用记分板来实现冲刷操作的功能。所有事务屏障指令均可释放写记分板，包括那些不写回任何结果的指令。



[0129] FIG. 9A shows an example_create() function 900 that sets up a new transaction barrier. In this example, the invoking code is responsible for invoking create( ) in only one thread. The create() function 900 takes as input parameters "Ptr" (the direct or indirect memory location where the barrier data structure is to be stored in memory) and "ExpectedArvCount" (the expected total number of the collection of threads and hardware transactions that are synchronized by this particular barrier). In the example shown, the transaction barrier data structure memory is initialized (902). For example, a memory block of a particular size (which may be specified as an input parameter to create( ) or predefined) at the memory location defined by Ptr may be initialized to0. The expected arrive count attribute of the transaction barrier is set to ExpectedArv-Count (904), and the arrive counter of the transaction barrier is set to ExpectedArvCount (to be increment on respective arrive( )) (906). As noted above, the expected arrive count attribute of the transaction barrier is used to reinitialize the arrive count attribute when the phase of the barrier changes, and the arrive counter is reinitialized with the negative of the expected arrive counter so that subsequent arrive() operations can simply increment the arrive counter towards 0 . The transaction count and phase count attributes are initialized to predetermined values (steps 908 and 910), and the now-initialized transaction barrier is stored to the specified location in memory (912). The predetermined values for trans-



[0129] 图9A 显示了一个示例性的 create() 函数 900，它设置了一个新的事务屏障。在此示例中，调用代码负责仅在单个线程中调用 create()。create() 函数 900 接受输入参数 “Ptr”（屏障数据结构将在内存中存储的直接或间接内存位置）和 “ExpectedArvCount”（由此特定屏障同步的线程和硬件事务集合的预期总数）。在所示示例中，事务屏障数据结构内存被初始化（902）。例如，在由 Ptr 定义的内存位置处，一个特定大小（可能作为 create() 的输入参数指定或是预定义的）的内存块可被初始化为 0。事务屏障的预期到达计数属性被设置为 ExpectedArvCount（904），并且事务屏障的到达计数器被设置为 ExpectedArvCount（以便在相应的 arrive() 时递增）（906）。如上所述，事务屏障的预期到达计数属性在屏障相位变化时用于重新初始化到达计数属性，并且到达计数器被重新初始化为预期到达计数器的负值，以便后续的 arrive() 操作可以简单地将到达计数器向 0 递增。事务计数和相位计数属性被初始化为预定值（步骤 908 和 910），随后已初始化的事务屏障被存储到指定的内存位置（912）。用于 trans- 的预定值

docs.title: US 2023/0289242 A1
docs.text:
action count and phase count may be 0 in some example embodiments. The function then returns (914), and in some embodiments, may return a value such as the phase counter value. As described above, in example embodiments the barrier can be stored to shared memory or in any desired memory in the memory hierarchy consistent with the scope of synchronization.

在一些示例实施例中，操作计数和阶段计数可以为0。然后该函数返回（914），并且在一些实施例中，可以返回一个值，例如阶段计数器值。如上所述，在示例实施例中，屏障可以存储到共享内存或内存层次结构中符合同步范围的任何所需内存。

[0130] In an example embodiment, the logic similar to the following may be implemented in the barrier datapath 700 for the _create():

[0130] 在一个示例实施例中，可以在屏障数据路径700中实现类似于以下的逻辑，用于_create()：

[0134] A temporary arrive count, based on which to subsequently update the transaction barrier's arrive count attribute, is determined based on the input parameter arvCnt (924). For example, the temporary arrive count may be set to the sum of the current value of the transaction barrier's arrival count and the arvCnt.

[0134] 临时到达计数基于输入参数arvCnt(924)来确定，随后将根据该临时到达计数更新事务屏障的到达计数属性。例如，临时到达计数可被设置为事务屏障的当前到达计数值与arvCnt之和。

[0135] An error check is performed (926). The error check may check, for example, for the temporary transaction count and the temporary arrive count being valid values.

[0135] 执行错误检查（926）。该错误检查例如可以检查临时交易计数和临时到达计数是否为有效值。

Int_Create(barSPtr, expectedArv, size) {

Int_Create(barSPtr, expectedArv, size) {

memset(barSPtr, 0, size);

memset(barSPtr, 0, size);

TransactionBarState_t trans= (TransactionBarState_t ) barSPtr;

TransactionBarState_t trans= (TransactionBarState_t ) barSPtr;

trans->expectedArv = -expectedArv; //'Negative unsigned number', implicit signed bit

trans->expectedArv = -expectedArv; //'负的无符号数'，隐式符号位

trans->arvCnt = -expectedArv;

trans->arvCnt = -expectedArv;

return trans->phase;

return trans->phase;

}.

}.

[0131] In some example embodiments, although the synchronization unit 700 supports the_create() function described above, hardware does not fully mitigate the software burden on creating the transaction barrier in the memory. Software may still need to enforce synchronization before using this hardware feature. Otherwise, there is risk of racing condition on the barrier creation (e.g. creating the barrier multiple times).

[0131] 在一些示例实施例中，虽然同步单元700支持上述_create()函数，但硬件并未完全减轻在内存中创建事务屏障的软件负担。软件在使用此硬件功能前可能仍需强制执行同步。否则，存在屏障创建出现竞态条件的风险（例如多次创建屏障）。

[0132] FIG. 9B shows an example_arrive() function 920 that is implemented in response to an arrive( ) operation in thread or a transaction. Arrive( ) is called by a thread to indicate that the thread has arrived at a transaction barrier. In some embodiments, the arrive( ) returns the barrier phase to be used for the wait( ) function 950 that would typically be called subsequently by the thread. The arrive( ) is also called by transactions, for example, to notify writing of data to a buffer by the synchronization unit. The input parameters to_arrive() include an address of the transaction barrier ("Ptr"), an arrive count ("arvCnt") and a transaction count ("transCnt").
