docs.title: DETAILED DESCRIPTION
docs.text:
50 Described herein are embodiments of communication protocols providing end-to-end reliability with the logic to provide one or both of ordered deliver and exactly-once delivery over an unreliable and unordered network.

50 本文描述了通信协议的实施例，其在不可靠且无序的网络上提供端到端可靠性，并具有提供有序传递和/或精确一次传递的逻辑。

In some multiprocessor systems, the individual processing nodes communicate over a switched network fabric, including communication of inter-node memory accesses (loads and store instructions). Memory accesses may be characterized as either ordered or unordered, and individual operations are executed either at least once or exactly once. 60 Some processing nodes may implement a relaxed memory ordering model. By extending ordering relaxation to network communication, data transfers benefit from performance improvements made possible by techniques such as adaptive routing and multi-pathing, without the utilization of 65 reordering logic, which may be expensive.

在某些多处理器系统中，各个处理节点通过交换网络结构进行通信，包括跨节点内存访问（加载和存储指令）的通信。内存访问可被描述为有序或无序，且单个操作执行至少一次或恰好一次。60 某些处理节点可能实现松散的内存排序模型。通过将排序松弛扩展到网络通信，数据传输受益于自适应路由和多路径等技术带来的性能提升，而无需使用 65 重排序逻辑，这可能成本昂贵。

However some performance-critical communication patterns may still require ordering. For example, some process-

然而，某些性能关键的通信模式可能仍然需要排序。例如，某些进程-

3 ing nodes may require sequential consistency per memory location that mandates accesses for the same memory address to be delivered in-order. Another example is bulk data transfers followed by a synchronization operation where the synchronization operation must not be executed before the data transfers have completed. Existing reliability and ordering protocols such as TCP or IB RC are not optimized for small, low-latency memory operations (e.g., reads and writes). These protocols also do not natively support networking features such as multi-pathing and dynamic adaptive routing.

3 个 ing 节点可能需要每个内存位置的顺序一致性，这要求对同一内存地址的访问按顺序交付。另一个例子是批量数据传输后跟一个同步操作，其中同步操作不能在数据传输完成之前执行。现有的可靠性和排序协议（如 TCP 或 IB RC）并未针对小型低延迟内存操作（例如读和写）进行优化。这些协议也不原生支持多路径和动态自适应路由等网络功能。

Conventional ordering protocols operate as though a flow of multiple packets to a same destination address begins when the first packet of the flow is sent. In reality, a same-address flow of packets becomes determined after the first request packet is sent, or more specifically, when subsequent packets access the same destination location.

传统的排序协议运行方式仿佛认为，发往同一目标地址的多个数据包流是从该流的第一个数据包发送时开始的。实际上，同一地址的数据包流是在发送第一个请求数据包之后才被确定的，或者更确切地说，是当后续数据包访问同一目标位置时才得以确定。

The protocol embodiments described herein utilize a technique referred to herein as "late on-the-fly connection setup". The disclosed protocols set up connections on the fly without requiring an explicit handshake before data is exchanged. The new protocols also defer setting up a connection until a packet directed to the same address as the first packet of the flow, and ordered after the first packet of 25 the flow, arrives at the destination.

本文描述的协议实施例利用了一种本文称为“后期即时连接建立”的技术。所公开的协议即时建立连接，而无需在数据交换之前进行显式的握手。新协议还推迟建立连接，直到一个数据包到达目的地，该数据包的目标地址与流的第一个数据包相同，并且该数据包在流的第一个数据包之后排序25。

Because some switching networks reorder packets, singletons may be mistaken for the first packet of a flow. The disclosed protocol embodiments utilize an identifier, for example the transaction id of the first packet, carrying over as the flow id attached to subsequent packets to create the correct association of packets to a flow at the receiver.

由于某些交换网络会对数据包进行重排序，单个数据包可能被误认为是流的第一个数据包。所公开的协议实施例利用一个标识符（例如第一个数据包的事务ID）作为延续，将其作为附加到后续数据包的流ID，从而在接收端正确建立数据包与流的关联。

Conventional protocols also do not distinguish the types of operations constituting a same-address flow of packets. These protocols therefore do not account for the possible need for a replay buffer for overlapped same-address operations that fetch data. In some processing systems, overlapping a memory load (LD) operation followed by a memory store (ST) operation requires a replay buffer for the operand fetched by the LD, in case the LD-ST sequence has to be retried. This provides correct observation order. To avoid the utilization of replay buffers, the disclosed protocols may serialize LDs followed by STs.

传统协议也没有区分构成相同地址数据包流的操作类型。因此，这些协议并未考虑为进行数据读取的重叠相同地址操作可能需要重放缓冲区的情况。在某些处理系统中，将内存加载（LD）操作之后紧跟内存存储（ST）操作相重叠，需要为LD读取的操作数设置重放缓冲区，以防LD-ST序列必须重试。这能提供正确的观察顺序。为避免使用重放缓冲区，所公开的协议可能会串行化LD后跟ST的操作序列。

When a failed LD is reissued, subsequent LDs (that might already have been successfully executed) have to be reexecuted as well, to guarantee correct observation order. The disclosed protocol embodiments may accomplish this by forwarding (the most recently received) LD responses to source memory, in order.

当一个失败的LD被重新发出时，随后的LD（可能已经成功执行）也必须被重新执行，以保证正确的观察顺序。所公开的协议实施例可以通过按顺序将（最近接收的）LD响应转发至源存储器来实现这一点。

Protocols may implement 'counted writes' to determine (at the destination) when the data packets have been delivered so that a synchronization operation may be executed. These protocols may fall back to source-side synchronization when transmission errors occur. Protocols may resynchronize source and destination when errors occur, so that synchronization may be performed on the destination side, instead of the source side.

协议可以实现“计数写入”，以（在目标端）确定数据包何时已送达，从而执行同步操作。当发生传输错误时，这些协议可能回退到源端同步。当错误发生时，协议可能重新同步源端和目标端，以便在目标端而不是源端执行同步。

The disclosed protocols assume an unreliable and unordered network, and may include:

所公开的协议假设了一个不可靠且无序的网络，并可能包括：

Late on-the-fly flow setup: A same-address flow of packets does not necessarily begin when a first packet is sent. In reality, a same-address flow of packets is determined after the first request packet is sent, that is, when subsequent requests access the same location. "Late on-the-fly flow setup" may be utilized such that flows are set up without requiring an explicit handshake

延迟动态流建立：同地址分组流并不一定在首个分组发送时即开始。实际上，同地址分组流是在第一个请求分组发送之后才确定的，即当后续请求访问相同位置时。利用“延迟动态流建立”可以在无需显式握手的情况下建立流。

4 before data is exchanged. Flow setup is deferred until a packet ordered after the first packet of the flow arrives.

4 在数据交换之前。流的建立被推迟，直到一个在流的第一个数据包之后排序的数据包到达为止。

Singleton delineation: Because the network may reorder packets, singletons may be mistaken for the first packet of a subsequent flow. A transaction id of the first packet may be carried over as the flow id attached to subsequent packets to create an association of packets to a flow at the receiver.

单包界定：由于网络可能会对数据包进行重排序，单包可能会被误认为是后续流的第一个数据包。第一个数据包的事务ID可能会作为流ID被携带到后续数据包上，从而在接收端建立数据包与流的关联。

No replay buffer for ordered flows: Overlapping a load (LD) followed by a store (ST) requires a replay buffer for the operand fetched by LD in case the LD-ST sequence has to be retried. This provides correct observation order. To avoid the need for replay buffers, LDs may be serialized, followed by STs.

有序流无需重放缓冲区：若一条加载（LD）与随后的一条存储（ST）重叠执行，则当 LD-ST 序列需要重试时，就需要一个重放缓冲区来保存 LD 所取出的操作数。这提供了正确的观察顺序。为避免对重放缓冲区的需求，可以将 LD 串行化，随后再执行 ST。

Ordered response delivery: When a failed LD is reissued, subsequent LDs (that might already have been successfully executed), may be re-executed as well to provide correct observation order. This may be implemented by forwarding (the most recently received) LD responses to source memory in order.

有序响应交付：当失败的加载指令被重新发出时，随后的加载指令（可能已经成功执行）也可能被重新执行以提供正确的观察顺序。这可以通过按顺序将（最近收到的）加载指令响应转发到源存储器来实现。

Error recovery for counted writes: Source and destination may be resynchronized when errors occur such that synchronization may still be done on the destination side.

计数写入的错误恢复：当错误发生时，源和目标可以重新同步，以便在目标端仍可完成同步。

The following disclosure may be better understood with reference to the following terms. Other terms should be accorded their ordinary meaning in the art unless otherwise indicated by context.

借助以下术语，可以更好地理解以下公开内容。除非上下文另有说明，其他术语应赋予其在本领域中的普通含义。

A request packet (REQ) transports an operation from the source to the destination. In return, a response packet (RSP) is sent from the destination to the source. If REQ contains a fetching operation such as a LD, RSP carries the fetched memory value. RSP also serves as an acknowledgment 35 (ACK) or negative acknowledgement (NACK).

请求包（REQ）将操作从源端传输到目的端。作为回应，一个响应包（RSP）会从目的端发回源端。如果REQ包含诸如LD之类的取数操作，RSP则携带所读取的内存值。RSP还充当确认35（ACK）或否定确认（NACK）。

The source sends a finalize request packet (FIN) to the destination to mark the end of the flow. The receipt of FIN has the destination deallocate the corresponding flow state. The destination sends a finalize response packet (FINACK) 40 to the source to acknowledge the receipt of FIN and the deallocation of the flow state.

源端向目的端发送一个结束请求包（FIN）以标记流的结束。收到FIN后，目的端会释放相应的流状态。目的端向源端发送一个结束响应包（FINACK）40，以确认已收到FIN并释放了流状态。

The source sends a go-back request packet (GBK) to the destination after an error has occurred to request resynchronization of the flow states kept at the source and destination. 45 The destination sends a go-back acknowledgment response packet (GBKACK) to the source to acknowledge resynchronization.

发生错误后，源端向目的端发送回退请求包（GBK），以请求重新同步源端和目的端所保存的流状态。45 目的端向源端发送回退确认响应包（GBKACK），以确认重新同步。

The sequence diagrams refer to the following header fields:

序列图指的是以下报头字段：

50 OP: operation type

50 OP：操作类型

TID: transaction identifier

TID：事务标识符

FID: flow identifier

FID：流标识符

SEQ: sequence number (starts at 1)

SEQ: 序列号（从1开始）

EOD: exactly once delivery

EOD：精确一次交付

5 ALOD: at-least once delivery

5 ALOD：至少一次交付

A transaction refers to a request/response exchange.

事务指一次请求/响应交换。

A flow refers to a sequence of overlapped requests/ operations that have to be executed in order. Opening and closing a flow refers to allocating and deallocating, respec- 60 tively, of state to correctly sequence the flow's packets.

流是指必须按顺序执行的一系列重叠请求/操作。打开和关闭流分别指分配和解除分配状态（respec- 60 tively），以正确地对流的数据包进行排序。

A singleton is a request/operation that does not belong to a multi-packet flow.

单例是一种不属于多包流的请求/操作。

Packets have a maximum lifetime (or time to life (TTL)). That is, packets will not emerge from the network after they 65 have expired.

数据包具有最大生存期（或生存时间（TTL））。也就是说，数据包在它们 65 过期之后将不再从网络中出现。

Example embodiments herein are presented herein for flows that include memory access commands that require ordered execution to preserve observation order. However, the techniques are more generally applicable whenever dependencies in packet flows require ordered delivery. Ordered delivery of packets carrying memory operations that access the same memory location is just one example of a data dependency that requires ordering. Other examples of possible applications include synchronization operations and IO traffic.

本文中的示例实施例针对包含内存访问命令的流，这些命令需要有序执行以保持观察顺序。然而，这些技术更普遍地适用于当数据包流中的依赖性要求有序传递的任何情况。承载访问相同内存位置的内存操作的数据包的有序传递，只是需要排序的数据依赖性的一个示例。其他可能应用示例包括同步操作和IO流量。

Consumer/producer communication patterns typically require synchronization after data has been exchanged. An example is a shared producer/consumer queue in which the producer writes an item into the queue and the consumer subsequently reads the item from the queue. In a distributed system, writing and reading a queue item can involve several packet transfers. Typically, to indicate that an entry was written as well as to indicate that an entry was read, a synchronization operation is executed, for example, to increment a counter after an entry was produced/written, and to decrement a counter after an entry was consumed/read. To avoid errors when accessing the queue, it has to be guaranteed that the synchronization operation is executed only after the entry was written or read. Thus, the synchronization operation requires ordered delivery in the sense that it must not be delivered before the operations to write or read the queue entry have been executed. If writing or reading a queue entry requires several packet transfers, there may be no ordering requirement for those transfers.

消费者/生产者通信模式通常要求在数据交换后进行同步。一个例子是共享的生产者/消费者队列，其中生产者将项写入队列，消费者随后从队列中读取该项。在分布式系统中，写入和读取队列项可能涉及多次数据包传输。通常，为了表明某个条目已被写入以及已被读取，会执行同步操作，例如在条目被生产/写入后递增计数器，并在条目被消费/读取后递减计数器。为避免访问队列时出错，必须保证同步操作仅在条目写入或读取之后执行。因此，同步操作要求有序交付，即它不得在写入或读取队列条目的操作完成之前被交付。如果写入或读取队列条目需要多次数据包传输，则这些传输之间可能没有顺序要求。

Many input/output (IO) standards such as Peripheral Component Interconnect (PCI) require ordering. In distributed systems, IO traffic is often transported over the network, in which case the network has to adhere to ordering rules given by the IO traffic. The reasons IO traffic requires ordering are manifold:

许多输入/输出（IO）标准，例如外设组件互连（PCI），要求排序。在分布式系统中，IO流量通常通过网络传输，此时网络必须遵守IO流量给出的排序规则。IO流量需要排序的原因是多方面的：

By ordering IO transactions, deadlock scenarios can be avoided.

通过对 IO 事务进行排序，可以避免死锁场景。

Many IO standards provide backwards compatibility with legacy standards that provide ordering.

许多IO标准提供了与提供排序的旧标准的向后兼容性。

Executing IO operations in the order specified by the programmer simplifies the programming model.

按照程序员指定的顺序执行 I/O 操作简化了编程模型。

Thus the mechanisms disclosed herein may also be applicable to consumer/producer and networked IO applications, for example.

FIG. 1 is a simplified depiction of a packet-based communication system 100 system in one embodiment. Protocol logic providing packet-based communication between a source node 102 and a destination node 124 is disposed in a source switch 126 and a destination switch 130 (with one or more potentially intermediate switches 128). Packet transport over the access links between the source node 102 and source switch 126, and the destination switch 130 and destination node 124, are ordered. The source switch 126 and the destination switch 130 comprise a shared memory 110 and shared memory 112, respectively. The re-transmission buffer 104 and response reorder buffer 120 of the source switch 126, and the replay buffer 118 and request reorder buffer 122 of the destination switch 130, are implemented in the shared memory 110 and shared memory 112, respectively. That is, once a packet has been received and stored in one of these memories 110, 112, the packet stays in place. "Moving" a packet to one of the reorder buffers 120, 122, or to the re-transmission buffer 104 or replay buffer 118, is reflected in the data structures used to manage memory, and does not require copying of the packet itself. Thus, no dedicated memory is needed to implement the various buffers and the ordering protocol will typically not exceed the capacity of the buffers once a packet has been recorded into the shared memory 110 or shared memory 112.

The source switch 126 comprises a same address filter 108 that tracks the outstanding requests and that determines whether a new request accesses an address already accessed by an outstanding request. The destination switch 130 comprises a history filter 114 that determines whether an incoming request belongs to a flow of which the first request was already received. The source switch 126 and the destination switch 130 both maintain flow states 106 and flow states 116, respectively, to correctly sequence forwarding of 10 requests and responses.

In other words, the transmitter determine a first condition of whether a subsequent memory access packet to transmit specifies access to a same memory address as is specified by one or more already transmitted and outstanding memory 15 access packets. (An outstanding memory access packet is one for which the memory operation specified in the packet has not yet been acknowledged or otherwise demonstrated to the transmitter as being completed). If this first condition is satisfied, the subsequent memory access packet is marked by 20 the transmitter with a same identifier as the one or more outstanding memory access packets specifying the same memory address. The receiver of the packets determines a second condition of whether a second packet received comprises the same identifier and a different sequence 25 numbers as a previously received packet. If this second condition is satisfied, the receiver establishes a packet flow (comprising the previously received packet and the second packet) with the transmitter.

Serializing a load followed by a store may obviate the need for replay buffers. If these operations were overlapped, the destination would maintain the load response in a replay buffer to avoid false results in case the load had to be retransmitted due to a transmission error after the store was executed. Eliminating the need for a replay buffer for loads is particularly impactful when the load/store sequence occurs at the beginning of the flow, and thus in some embodiments serialization may be implemented for that circumstance in particular. Without serialization, the destination may need to store every load response in a replay buffer, even for singletons.

Retransmission may cause duplicate load responses (e.g., in FIG. 5A, RSP2 and RSP3 are received twice). Therefore the source may ignore load responses received prior to 65 go-back (GBK). Referring to FIG. 5A, the RSP2 . . . 3 packets received prior to GBK are dropped. This implies that load responses should be forwarded to source memory in order and, if multiple copies of some response packet RSPn are received, the RSP packet most recently received should be forwarded. Otherwise, if an out-of-order RSP is forwarded to source memory, an outstanding RSP with a lower sequence number could cause a time-out, making it necessary to re-execute loads and thus invalidate an already forwarded response. This is, for example, the case in FIG. 5A when packets RSP2 . . . 3 are received the first time before the go-back handshake. In-order delivery of responses necessitates a response buffer to hold RSPs until they are in order.

重传可能导致重复的加载响应（例如，图5A中，RSP2和RSP3被接收两次）。因此，源端可忽略在65回退（GBK）之前收到的加载响应。参照图5A，在GBK之前收到的RSP2...3包被丢弃。这意味着加载响应应按序转发至源内存，并且如果收到某个响应包RSPn的多个副本，则应转发最近收到的RSP包。否则，若将失序的RSP转发至源内存，则序列号较低的未完成RSP可能导致超时，从而需要重新执行加载并使得已转发的响应失效。例如，图5A中首次接收到RSP2...3包时（在回退握手之前）即为此种情形。响应的按序交付需要一个响应缓冲区来暂存RSP，直至其排序就绪。

Alternative (more complicated) implementations to deal with transmission errors may be considered. In FIG. 5A, FIG. 5B, and FIG. 5C, when RSP2 is received by the source, and after the time-out caused by the loss of RSP1, RSP1 may be derived from RSP2. The receipt of RSP2 by the source implies that the destination has executed REQ1 even if RSP1 has not been received. In FIG. 5A, the value returned by RSP2 may be used as the return value of the (missing) RSP1. Even if the destination memory had changed and the actual fetched values of REQ1 and REQ2 are different, using the return value generated by REQ2 twice is acceptable because the observation order has been followed. In FIG. 5A, FIG. 5B, and FIG. 5C, the receipt of RSP2 may be interpreted as an ACK for REQ1.

可考虑采用其他（更复杂的）实现方式来处理传输错误。在图5A、图5B和图5C中，当源端收到RSP2后，以及因RSP1丢失导致超时之后，可以从RSP2推导出RSP1。源端收到RSP2意味着目标端已执行REQ1，即使未收到RSP1。在图5A中，RSP2返回的值可用作（缺失的）RSP1的返回值。即使目标端存储器内容已发生变化，且REQ1和REQ2实际取回的值不同，由于遵循了观察顺序，使用REQ2生成的返回值两次也是可接受的。在图5A、图5B和图5C中，收到RSP2可被解释为对REQ1的确认。

The examples in FIG. 5A, FIG. 5B, and FIG. 5C may suggest that only LDs but not STs may be delivered more than once. However this is not the case. For example, if in FIG. 5B no flow were available when the first copy of REQ2 is received, REQ1 would re-executed after the go-back handshake.

图5A、图5B和图5C中的示例可能表明只有LD而非ST可以被多次传送。然而情况并非如此。例如，如果在图5B中收到REQ2的第一个副本时没有可用的流，则在回退握手后REQ1将重新执行。

图6A描绘了用于加载操作的丢失REQ数据包的一个示例。图6B描绘了用于存储操作的丢失REQ数据包的一个示例。图6C描绘了用于存储操作后跟加载操作的丢失REQ数据包的一个示例。

These examples involve the loss of a REQ packet. In the examples, REQ1 is lost and, thus, the destination receives REQ2 . . . 3 out-of-order and stores these packets in the reorder buffer. Because RSP1 is missing, the time-out timer eventually expires, causing a go-back handshake. This removes REQ2 and REQ3 from the reorder buffer and sets the sequence pointer to 1 (one). In all three scenarios, REQ1 . . . 3 are resent and eventually executed, with no operation being executed prior to the go-back handshake. A flow at the receiver is already in place at the time GBK is received. This does not necessarily have to be the case. Thus, when GBK is received and no receiver flow had been opened, a new flow may be opened.

这些示例涉及一个 REQ 数据包的丢失。在这些示例中，REQ1 丢失，因此目的地乱序接收到 REQ2 . . . 3，并将这些包存储在重排序缓冲区中。由于缺少 RSP1，超时计时器最终超时，引发一次回退握手。这将从重排序缓冲区中移除 REQ2 和 REQ3，并将序列指针设置为 1（一）。在所有三种场景中，REQ1 . . . 3 都会被重传并最终执行，且在回退握手之前不会有任何操作被执行。在接收到 GBK 时，接收方上的流已建立。这并非总是如此。因此，当接收到 GBK 且尚未打开接收方流时，可以打开一个新流。

Time-Out Timer

超时定时器

FIG. 7 depicts an example of a reset time-out when a REQ packet is sent. Because packets have a maximum lifetime, a time-out timer may be used to detect the loss of a packet. A time-out timer could be initiated for every packet sent into the network. However, checking a timer for every outstanding packet creates significant overhead. The schemes described below utilize only one (or two) timer(s) per flow.

图7展示了发送REQ数据包时重置超时的示例。由于数据包具有最大生存期，可采用超时定时器来检测数据包丢失。可为发送到网络中的每个数据包启动一个超时定时器。然而，检查每个未完成数据包的定时器会带来显著开销。下述方案每个流仅使用一个（或两个）定时器。

A single timer per flow may be reset every time a REQ is sent. If the timer expires and there are outstanding REQs, a REQ or RSP has been lost and a GBK/GBKACK sequence is triggered. In the example in FIG. 7, the timer is started when REQ1 is sent, and reset when REQ2 and REQ3, respectively, are sent. Since RSP1 is lost, the timer times out, triggering a GBK/GBKACK handshake.

每个流的单个定时器可在每次发送REQ时被重置。如果定时器超时且存在未完成的REQ，则某个REQ或RSP已丢失，并触发GBK/GBKACK序列。在图7的示例中，定时器在发送REQ1时启动，并分别在发送REQ2和REQ3时重置。由于RSP1丢失，定时器超时，触发GBK/GBKACK握手。

The time-out timer is also started/reset when GBK or FIN are sent to capture errors occurring during GBK/GBKACK

当发送 GBK 或 FIN 时，超时定时器也会被启动/重置，以捕获在 GBK/GBKACK 期间发生的错误。

10 and FIN/FINACK handshakes. If any of these packets are lost, a timeout will occur and the corresponding handshake is re-tried.

10 和 FIN/FINACK 握手。如果这些数据包中有任何一个丢失，就会发生超时，并且相应的握手将重新尝试。

The time-out time has to be set to a value which is greater 5 than twice the maximum packet lifetime (to cover REQ as well as RSP forwarding times). When the time-out timer expires, there is high confidence that no more RSPs will be received.

超时时间必须设置为一个大于5的最大数据包生存期的两倍的值（以覆盖REQ和RSP转发时间）。当超时定时器到期时，可以高度确信不会再收到RSP。

For long flows, it could potentially take a long time for an 10 error to be detected as the timer is reset every time a REQ is sent. Furthermore, a significant amount of reorder buffer space might be consumed because every REQ received after a lost REQ is treated as out-of-order. Different measures may be implemented to prevent this. A maximum flow 15 length may be enforced that bounds the time it takes to report an error and also limits the number of entries in the retransmission and reorder buffers taken up by the flow. Another option is to add a mechanism at the destination that detects that no progress is being made. Such a mechanism 20 may use a timer to detect that entries have not been forwarded for some configured period of time, or limit/bound the consumption of reorder buffers by a flow. Lack of progress may be reported back to the source by a NACK indicating a timeout or excess of buffers used, respectively.

对于长流，错误检测可能需要很长时间，因为每当发送一个 REQ 时，计时器会被重置。此外，由于丢失的 REQ 之后接收到的每个 REQ 都会被视作乱序，可能会消耗大量的重排序缓冲区空间。可以实施不同的措施来防止这种情况。可以通过设置最大流长度限制来强制界定错误报告所需的时间，并限制流所占用的重传和重排序缓冲区条目的数量。另一种选择是在接收端增加一种机制，用于检测是否没有取得进展。这种机制可以使用定时器来检测在某个设定的时间段内条目未被转发，或者限制/界定某个流对重排序缓冲区的消耗。进展的中断可分别通过指示超时或缓冲区使用过多的 NACK 报告给源端。

FIG. 8 depicts an example of a reset time-out when a RSP packet is received. The time-out timer is reset when the next in-order RSP is forwarded to source memory (rather than when a REQ is sent). The scheme relies on ordered return of RSPs to source memory. Because this is already implemented in the ordering protocol, no additional logic is required. An additional timer is utilized to ensure that outstanding REQs have timed out before the go-back handshake begins. This timer is reset every time a REQ is sent.

图8描绘了当接收到RSP包时复位超时的示例。超时计时器在下一个按序的RSP被转发到源内存时复位（而不是在发送REQ时）。该方案依赖于RSP有序返回到源内存。由于这在排序协议中已实现，因此不需要额外的逻辑。利用一个额外的计时器来确保在回退握手开始之前，未完成的REQ已经超时。该计时器在每次发送REQ时复位。

In FIG. 8, timer1 is the timer that is reset when the next 35 in-order RSP is received. Timer2 is the timer reset whenever a REQ is sent. In the example RSP2 is lost, as captured by the time-out of Timer1, which is reset when RSP1 was received. The protocol waits for Timer2 to expire to ensure all RSPs are received before the go-back handshake. RSP3 arrives while waiting for Timer2 to expire. In FIG. 8, Timer2 is depicted as being reset when REQ3 is sent.

在图8中，timer1是当收到下一个按序的35 RSP时重置的计时器。Timer2是每当发送REQ时重置的计时器。在示例中，RSP2丢失，由Timer1的超时捕获，该计时器在收到RSP1时被重置。协议等待Timer2到期，以确保在回退握手之前收到所有RSP。在等待Timer2到期期间，RSP3到达。在图8中，Timer2被描绘为在发送REQ3时重置。

An advantage of this scheme is that the time to detect the loss of a packet is bound by 2*max_packet_lifetime, and no restrictions on flow length need be imposed.

该方案的一个优势在于，检测数据包丢失的时间受到 2*max_packet_lifetime 的限制，且无需对流长度施加任何限制。

FIG. 11 depicts an example of flow reassembly. Because REQs may be reordered in the network, the arrival of a singleton may be interleaved with the arrival of the REQs of a subsequent flow. If all REQs carry operations accessing the same address, additional information is needed to disambiguate the singleton and the flow. In FIG. 11 a singleton (topmost REQ and RSP) is followed by a flow (remaining packet transfers) with all REQs carrying operations for the same destination address. In the example, REQ1 and REQ2 of the flow (not the singleton) arrive out of order. When REQ2 arrives first, it should not be considered in order by falsely concluding that the preceding singleton was the first REQ of the flow.

图11展示了一个流重组的示例。由于REQ在网络中可能被重排序，单例的到达可能与后续流的REQ到达交错。如果所有REQ携带的操作都访问相同的地址，则需要额外信息来区分单例和流。在图11中，一个单例（顶部的REQ和RSP）之后跟着一个流（剩余的数据包传输），且该流的所有REQ都携带针对相同目标地址的操作。在此示例中，流（而非单例）的REQ1和REQ2乱序到达。当REQ2先到达时，不应错误地推断先前的单例是流的第一个REQ，从而将REQ2视为按序到达。

A mechanism may be utilized to distinguish between a singleton and a subsequent flow. In one embodiment, a 'late-binding method' is utilized to associate REQs with a flow by reusing the TID of the first request as the FID for the subsequent REQs of the flow. In FIG. 11, at the time REQ1 of the flow is sent, it is not known whether it starts a flow and, thus, no FID is provided. A flow is established with the transmission of REQ2. An FID is attached to REQ2 and subsequent REQs. To be able to associate the REQ1 of the flow with the followings REQ2-3, the FID is set to the value of TID of the REQ1 of the flow. This way, the destination has enough information to correctly re-assemble the flow (and delineate it from the preceding singleton).

The destination may utilize a history filter to determine whether a REQ2 is in order; that is, whether REQ1 has been received and forwarded. In the example of FIG. 11, REQ2 arrives first at the destination, at which time no flow state has been allocated. The history filter is looked up using the key . No entry is found and REQ2 is correctly considered out-of-order.

目的地可以利用历史过滤器来确定 REQ2 是否按序到达；即，REQ1 是否已被接收并转发。在图 11 的例子中，REQ2 首先到达目的地，此时尚未分配任何流状态。使用键 查找历史过滤器。未找到条目，REQ2 被正确地视为乱序。

To help ensure correct operation, entries in the history filter should expire before the corresponding TID is recycled and reused. In order to time out entries in the history filter, entries may be supplied with a timestamp when they are entered. When they are retrieved and the timestamp indicates that they have expired, entries may be ignored.

为确保正确运行，历史过滤器中的条目应在相应的 TID 被回收和重用之前过期。为使历史过滤器中的条目超时，可在条目录入时为其提供一个时间戳。当条目被检索到且时间戳表明其已过期时，可将其忽略。

In a pool of n TIDs with a maximum of \(\mathrm{m}\) outstanding REQs there are n-m 'free' TIDs. If the free TIDs are stored in a FIFO and recycled cyclically, it takes at least (n-m)t_s time, where t_s is the packet serialization time, before a TID is reused. For example, if \(\mathrm{m} = {1000},\mathrm{n} = {5000}\) and t_s=328 bits1/200 Gbit/s=1.28 ns (where 32 bytes is the minimum packet size and 200 Gbit/s is the transmission rate), the reuse interval is >=40001.28 ns=5.2 us, which in turn determines the maximum lifetime t_h of an entry in the history filter.

在一个包含n个TID的池中，最多允许\(\mathrm{m}\)个未完成REQ，因此有n-m个“空闲”TID。如果这些空闲TID以FIFO方式存储并循环回收，那么一个TID被重用之前至少需要经过(n-m)t_s的时间，其中t_s是数据包序列化时间。例如，若\(\mathrm{m} = {1000},\mathrm{n} = {5000}\)，且t_s=328 bits1/200 Gbit/s=1.28 ns（其中32字节为最小数据包大小，200 Gbit/s为传输速率），则重用间隔>=40001.28 ns=5.2 us，这反过来决定了历史过滤器中条目存在的最大生存时间t_h。

The size of the history filter is determined by the amount of time REQ1 packets have to be remembered. In FIG. 11, REQ2 of the flow arrives at the destination no later than the round trip time (RTT) after REQ1 of the flow (ignoring network skews) - otherwise the two REQs do not belong to the same flow. Therefore, the maximum capacity of the history filter is RTT/t_s, where t_s is the packet serialization delay. For example, if RTT=7 us and t_s=1.28 ns, a maximum of \(\mathrm{e} = 5,{469}\) entries are needed.

历史过滤器的大小取决于需要记忆REQ1数据包的时长。在图11中，流的REQ2数据包到达目的地的时间不会晚于该流的REQ1数据包的往返时间（RTT）（忽略网络偏差），否则这两个REQ就不属于同一条流。因此，历史过滤器的最大容量为RTT/t_s，其中t_s是数据包序列化延迟。例如，若RTT=7微秒，t_s=1.28纳秒，则最多需要\(\mathrm{e} = 5,{469}\)个条目。

Anther constraint as noted above is the maximum allowed lifetime t_h of an entry in the history filter. If t_h=5.2 us as in the example above, considering both constraints, e*t_s<min(RTT, t_h) results in e=4,063 entries.

如前所述，另一个约束是历史过滤器中条目的最大允许生存时间 t_h。若如上例所示 t_h = 5.2 微秒，综合考虑这两个约束，e*t_s < min(RTT, t_h) 得到 e = 4,063 个条目。

如果 t_h < RTT，源节点必须保证 REQ2 最多在 REQ1 注入后 t_h 时间内被注入。如果无法满足这一时序约束，REQ2 的注入必须

be to delayed until after RSP1 is received (in which case REQ2 becomes another REQ1).

被延迟到接收到 RSP1 之后（在这种情况下，REQ2 变成另一个 REQ1）。

Non-idempotent operations such as atomics may require exactly-once delivery. In order to be able to detect dupli- 5 cates, a flow may be utilized to keep track of the requests that have been delivered. In contrast to the protocol described above for at least once delivery (ALOD), exactly once delivery (EOD) may require a flow to be established as soon as the first request of a flow is received.

非幂等操作，例如原子操作，可能需要恰好一次交付。为了能够检测 dupli- 5 cates，可以利用一个流来跟踪已交付的请求。与上文所述的至少一次交付（ALOD）协议相比，恰好一次交付（EOD）可能要求在接收到流的第一个请求时立即建立流。

'Duplicate' refers to a packet that is a copy of a prior packet and, thus, indistinguishable from the original (prior) packet. Duplicate and original packet do not necessarily have to be present at the same time in the network.

“重复”指一个数据包，它是之前数据包的副本，因此与原始（之前的）数据包无法区分。重复数据包和原始数据包不一定需要同时存在于网络中。

In addition to flow state, EOD may further require replay 5 buffers if operations fetch data in order to be able to 'replay' responses of failed REQ/RSP transactions. A protocol for EOD may handle transmission errors using the previously described time-out and go-back mechanisms.

除了流状态之外，如果操作需要获取数据以便能够‘重新播放’失败的REQ/RSP事务的响应，EOD可能还需要5个重播缓冲区。用于EOD的协议可能利用先前描述的超时与回退机制来处理传输错误。

FIG. 20 depicts an example of synchronized transfer. A synchronized transfer (STR) comprises an unordered transfer of data packets followed by a synchronization operation. An STR implements destination-side synchronization thereby avoiding any RTT-delays between the end of the data transfer and the synchronization operation. In FIG. 20 there are three data packets REQ1 . . . 3 followed by a synchronization operation in REQ4. REQ1 . . . 3 are forwarded to destination memory in the order they arrive. REQ4 comprises the synchronization operation that requires EOD and should only be forwarded to destination memory after all data packets have been delivered. In the example, REQ4 arrives at the destination before all data packets are forwarded to destination memory and is, thus, temporarily kept in a reorder buffer until the data portion has completed.

图20展示了一个同步传输的示例。同步传输（STR）包含无序的数据包传输及随后的同步操作。STR实现了目的端同步，从而避免了数据传输结束与同步操作之间的任何往返时延。在图20中，有三个数据包REQ1…3，随后在REQ4中进行同步操作。REQ1…3按到达顺序转发至目的内存。REQ4包含同步操作，该操作需要EOD，并应仅在所有数据包均已交付后才转发至目的内存。在此示例中，REQ4在所有数据包被转发至目的内存之前就已到达目的地，因此临时存放在重排序缓冲区中，直至数据部分完成。

Some bookkeeping is utilized to determine when the synchronization operation may be released. One scheme that may be utilized uses counted writes. A counter tracks the data packets at the destination to determine when the synchronization operation may be executed. The condition for executing the synchronization operation may be considered met when the counter has accounted for all data packets.

采用某些簿记机制来确定同步操作可被释放的时机。一种可行的方案是利用计数写入。通过一个计数器跟踪目的地处的数据包，以判定同步操作何时可以执行。当该计数器已计入所有数据包时，可视为满足同步操作的执行条件。

FIG. 21 depicts an example of synchronized transfer using a counter for tracking packets. An STR comprising three data packets REQ1 . . . 3 each for a store operation is followed by a synchronization packet REQ4 for the synchronization operation. REQ4 carries a count CNT=4 that specifies the total number of packets making up the STR. The destination counts the REQ packets and when the counter reaches CNT, the condition is met to forward and execute the synchronization operation. In the example, REQ1 and REQ3 arrive out-of-order. The order of the data packets REQ1 . . . 3 does not matter, so the destination forwards them to destination memory as they arrive. REQ4 with the synchronization operation, however, has to be ordered with respect to the data packets. Because it arrives out-of-order, it has to be stored in the reorder buffer until after the last data packet REQ3 is received.

图21示出了使用计数器跟踪数据包的同步传输示例。一个由三个分别用于存储操作的数据包REQ1…3组成的STR后跟一个用于同步操作的同步包REQ4。REQ4携带一个计数值CNT=4，指定组成STR的数据包总数。目的地对REQ包进行计数，当计数器达到CNT时，满足转发并执行同步操作的条件。在该示例中，REQ1和REQ3乱序到达。数据包REQ1…3的顺序无关紧要，因此目的地会在它们到达时将它们转发到目的存储器。然而，带有同步操作的REQ4必须相对于数据包进行排序。因为它是乱序到达的，所以必须将其存储在重排序缓冲区中，直到最后一个数据包REQ3被接收后。

The data and synchronization packets are associated with a flow identifier FID that both the source and destination use to keep track of the transfer. The flow state needed at the destination is the aforementioned packet counter. The destination opens a flow with the receipt of the first REQ which is REQ2 in the example. Flow state at both the source and destination is removed by the FIN/FINACK handshake. In FIG. 21, it is assumed that resources such as flow state and reorder buffer are available and not exhausted.

数据包和同步数据包都与一个流标识符FID相关联，源端和目的地都使用该FID来跟踪传输过程。目的地所需的流状态是前述的数据包计数器。目的地在收到第一个REQ（在示例中为REQ2）时打开一个流。源端和目的地两端的流状态都通过FIN/FINACK握手来移除。在图21中，假设流状态和重排序缓冲区等资源是可用的且未被耗尽。

A robust STR protocol should include mechanisms to recover from transmission errors. Simply resending a REQ in response to a transmission error may be insufficient because the destination might count REQs more than once (if the RSP is lost) and thereby get out of sync. To avoid this, the 'go back' handshake introduced above may be utilized to reset the destination counter and resynchronize source and destination states.

一个稳健的 STR 协议应包含从传输错误中恢复的机制。仅仅在发生传输错误时重发 REQ 可能不够，因为如果 RSP 丢失，目的地可能会多次计数 REQ，从而导致失步。为避免这种情况，可以利用上文介绍的“回退”握手来重置目的地计数器，并重新同步源和目的地状态。

FIG. 22 depicts an example of a lost REQ packet. A time-out timer is applied to detect the loss of packets. Before retransmission, a GBK/GBKACK exchange takes place that informs the destination to reset the packet counter to 0 (zero) and remove the synchronization operation from the reorder buffer if it already has been received.

图22描绘了一个丢失的REQ数据包的示例。应用超时定时器来检测数据包的丢失。在重传之前，进行一次GBK/GBKACK交换，该交换通知目的地将数据包计数器重置为0（零），并且如果同步操作已被接收，则将其从重排序缓冲区中移除。

The time-out timer may be implemented in a number of ways, for example:

超时定时器可以通过多种方式实现，例如：

  1. Each REQ is associated with a time-out timer. The timer is started when the REQ is sent and it is stopped when the corresponding RSP is received. When a timer times out, an error occurred. No more REQs are sent and another timer is started that expires when it is guaranteed that no more RSPs may be received.
  1. 每个REQ都与一个超时定时器相关联。发送REQ时启动该定时器，收到对应的RSP时停止该定时器。当定时器超时时，即发生错误。不再发送任何REQ，并且启动另一个定时器，该定时器在确保不会再收到任何RSP时到期。
  1. A single time-out timer is used that is reset whenever a REQ is sent. The timer is stopped when all RSPs have been received. When the timer times out, one or more of the REQ/RSP transactions have failed.
  1. 使用单一超时计时器，在每次发送 REQ 时都会重置。当所有 RSP 均已接收，该计时器停止。若该计时器超时，则意味着一个或多个 REQ/RSP 事务已失败。

An advantage of the first option is that transmission errors are detected quicker than with the second option where an 15 error will only be detected when the time-out timer expires that was reset when the last REQ was sent. On the other hand, the first option is more complex because it requires a time-out timer for each REQ whereas the second option only uses one timer. Computing devices, such as central processing units and graphics processing units, implement a memory consistency model, which provides guarantees about the order in which a set of events appear to occur. A memory consistency model is conventionally a memory system implementation problem, because it requires the ordering of memory operations (loads and stores) within a chip. Some memory systems (e.g., Nvidia's NVLink and NVSwitch networked systems) extend the memory model across many computing devices by transporting memory operations over a packet switched network. As network systems scale from tens to thousands of endpoints, enforcing packet ordering in the network becomes onerous and reduces performance. If the network cannot guarantee packet ordering, it will violate the memory consistency model. Because enforcing ordering in the network reduces performance, endpoint devices (the final target of transported memory operations) may reorder packets to enforce a memory consistency model. To reorder packets, an endpoint puts a packet in a reorder buffer until all other relevant packets arrive, and the endpoint appropriately reorders the packets according to the memory consistency model.

中央处理器和图形处理器等计算设备会实现内存一致性模型，该模型为一系列事件表现出的发生顺序提供了保证。内存一致性模型通常属于内存系统实现问题，因为它要求对芯片内部的内存操作（加载和存储）进行排序。某些内存系统（例如英伟达的NVLink和NVSwitch网络系统）通过分组交换网络传输内存操作，将内存模型扩展到众多计算设备上。随着网络系统从数十个端点扩展到数千个，在网络中强制分组排序变得繁重且会降低性能。如果网络无法保证分组顺序，就会破坏内存一致性模型。由于在网络中强制排序会降低性能，端点设备（所传输内存操作的最终目标）可以对分组进行重新排序，以维护内存一致性模型。为了对分组重新排序，端点会将分组放入重排序缓冲区，直到所有其他相关分组到达，然后端点根据内存一致性模型对这些分组进行适当的重新排序。

A history filter may be utilized at each endpoint to identify recently received packets. When the first packet in a flow arrives at an endpoint, the endpoint allocates an entry in the history filter. The endpoint does not know at this juncture whether the packet is a singleton or the first packet of a longer flow. If the packet is a singleton, it will be evicted from the history filter after the timeout period elapses. If the packet is the first of multiple packets in a longer flow, a subsequent (to the first) packet in the flow will eventually arrive at the endpoint, and in response the endpoint will establish a flow by looking up the first packet of the flow in the history filter. However, this will not happen if the latency between the first packet and the second packet is longer than the eviction deadline for the history filter.

每个端点可利用历史过滤器来识别近期接收的数据包。当一条流的首个数据包到达端点时，端点会在历史过滤器中分配一条记录。此时端点并不知道该数据包是单独的数据包，还是一条较长流中的第一个数据包。如果该数据包是单独的数据包，它将在超时周期结束后从历史过滤器中被剔除。如果该数据包是一条较长流中多个数据包的第一个，那么该流中后续（相对于第一个）的数据包最终会到达端点，作为响应，端点将通过查询历史过滤器中的第一个数据包来建立一条流。然而，如果第一个数据包与第二个数据包之间的延迟超过了历史过滤器的剔除截止时间，上述过程将不会发生。

The history filter uniquely identifies a flow based on a source identifier (e.g., source endpoint) and flow identifier (e.g., memory address). The history filter may be implemented as a small cache of recently accessed arrived packets. Packets remain in the history filter for a preset duration and then are evicted. If the second packet, i.e., packet B, of a flow arrives and the first packet, packet A, was evicted, packet B exists without context of whether packet A arrived or not. In this scenario packet B would be maintained in the history filter awaiting the arrival of packet A, which has

A "fast path" mechanism may be utilized to reduce the probability that a history filter evicts an entry when subsequent packets are still in the network. This prevents the chance of an eviction from the history filter that leads to undesirable retransmission(s).

可以采用“快速路径”机制来降低历史过滤器在后续数据包仍在网络中时逐出条目的概率。这避免了历史过滤器因逐出操作而导致非必要重传的可能性。

As explained above, a large skew between packets within the same flow may result in unnecessary retransmissions when the history filter evicts a flow before other packets of the flow arrive. To reduce skew between packets that need to be ordered, mechanisms may be implemented to "fast path" the second packet in a flow. The second packet establishes a flow at the destination, where flows are evicted after a predetermined amount of time. By "fast pathing" a packet, it will traverse the network quickly, thereby reducing the likelihood that the packet arrives after the history filter evicts the first packet in the flow.

如上所述，同一流内数据包之间偏差较大时，若历史过滤器在其他数据包到达前就驱逐了该流，可能导致不必要的重传。为了减少需要排序的数据包之间的偏差，可以实现机制对流中的第二个数据包进行“快速路径”处理。第二个数据包在目的地建立一个流，而流在预定时间后被驱逐。通过对数据包实施“快速路径”，它将快速穿越网络，从而降低该数据包在历史过滤器驱逐流中第一个数据包之后才到达的可能性。

By limiting the latency of packets that establish flows, the system may more rapidly evict singletons from the history filter or move them to the reorder buffer. In conventional approaches, limiting the latency of flow-establishing packets 25 may involve limiting the amount of traffic in the network. Most latency in a network may result from packet queueing delays, and limiting the amount of traffic limits the amount of queueing delay because the size of queues are bounded by the number of in-flight packets. Limiting the amount of 30 traffic negatively impacts the throughput of the network. By limiting the number of packets that each end-host can inject, the end-hosts cannot saturate the network, which reduces the overall throughput of the network. This means that for some applications reducing the network throughput to reduce 35 packet latencies is not an option.

通过限制建立流的数据包的延迟，系统可以更快速地从历史过滤器中驱逐单包，或将它们移至重排序缓冲区。在传统方法中，限制建立流的数据包 25 的延迟可能涉及限制网络中的流量。网络中的大多数延迟可能源于数据包排队延迟，而限制流量便限制了排队延迟，因为队列大小受限于在途数据包的数量。限制流量 30 对网络吞吐量产生负面影响。通过限制每个终端主机可注入的数据包数量，终端主机无法使网络饱和，从而降低了网络的整体吞吐量。这意味着对于某些应用而言，通过降低网络吞吐量来减少 35 数据包延迟是不可行的。

In some embodiments, a fast path may be implemented using age based arbitration. Age based arbitration sorts packets by their age. The older a packet is, the higher priority it is. By setting the age of packets that establish flows to a very large value, or to infinity, the packet may be moved quickly through the network, ahead of other packets with lower ages. One or more parallel processing unit 2820 modules may 20 be configured to accelerate thousands of High Performance Computing (HPC), data center, and machine learning applications. The parallel processing unit 2820 may be configured to accelerate numerous deep learning systems and applications including autonomous vehicle platforms, deep learn- 25 ing, high-accuracy speech, image, and text recognition systems, intelligent video analytics, molecular simulations, drug discovery, disease diagnosis, weather forecasting, big data analytics, astronomy, molecular dynamics simulation, financial modeling, robotics, factory automation, real-time language translation, online search optimizations, and personalized user recommendations, and the like.

一个或多个并行处理单元2820模块可20被配置为加速数千个高性能计算（HPC）、数据中心和机器学习应用。该并行处理单元2820可被配置为加速众多深度学习系统与应用，包括自主车辆平台、深度学-25习、高精度语音、图像和文本识别系统、智能视频分析、分子模拟、药物发现、疾病诊断、天气预报、大数据分析、天文学、分子动力学模拟、金融建模、机器人、工厂自动化、实时语言翻译、在线搜索优化以及个性化用户推荐等。

As shown in FIG. 28, the parallel processing unit 2820 includes an I/O unit 2802, a front-end unit 2804, a scheduler unit 2808, a work distribution unit 2810, a hub 2806, a 5 crossbar 2814, one or more general processing cluster 2900 modules, and one or more memory partition unit 3000 modules. The parallel processing unit 2820 may be connected to a host processor or other parallel processing unit 2820 modules via one or more high-speed NVLink 2816 40 interconnects. Embodiments of the protocols described herein may be implemented for communication between various components of the parallel processing unit 2820 over the NVLinks 2816 and/or the crossbar 2814.

如图28所示，并行处理单元2820包括一个I/O单元2802、一个前端单元2804、一个调度器单元2808、一个工作分配单元2810、一个集线器2806、一个5交叉开关2814、一个或多个通用处理集群2900模块以及一个或多个内存分区单元3000模块。并行处理单元2820可通过一个或多个高速NVLink 2816 40互连连接到主机处理器或其他并行处理单元2820模块。本文描述的协议实施例可被实现用于并行处理单元2820的各个组件之间通过NVLink 2816和/或交叉开关2814进行的通信。

The parallel processing unit 2820 may be connected to a 45 host processor or other peripheral devices via an interconnect 2818. The parallel processing unit 2820 may also be connected to a local memory comprising a number of memory 2812 devices. In an embodiment, the local memory may comprise a number of dynamic random access memory

并行处理单元2820可通过互连2818连接至45主机处理器或其他外围设备。并行处理单元2820还可连接至包含若干内存2812设备的本地存储器。在一个实施例中，本地存储器可包含多个动态随机存取存储器。

50 (DRAM) devices. The DRAM devices may be configured as a high-bandwidth memory (HBM) subsystem, with multiple DRAM dies stacked within each device. The memory 2812 may comprise logic to configure the parallel processing unit 2820 to carry out aspects of the techniques disclosed herein.

50个DRAM器件。这些DRAM器件可被配置为高带宽内存（HBM）子系统，每个器件内堆叠有多个DRAM裸片。存储器2812可包含用于配置并行处理单元2820以执行本文所公开技术的各个方面的逻辑。

55 The NVLink 2816 interconnect enables systems to scale and include one or more parallel processing unit 2820 modules combined with one or more CPUs, supports cache coherence between the parallel processing unit 2820 modules and CPUs, and CPU mastering. Data and/or commands 60 may be transmitted by the NVLink 2816 through the hub 2806 to/from other units of the parallel processing unit 2820 such as one or more copy engines, a video encoder, a video decoder, a power management unit, etc. (not explicitly shown). The NVLink 2816 is described in more detail in 65 conjunction with FIG. 32.

55 NVLink 2816互连使系统能够扩展并包含一个或多个与一个或多个CPU组合的并行处理单元2820模块，支持并行处理单元2820模块与CPU之间的缓存一致性，以及CPU主控。数据和/或命令60可由NVLink 2816通过集线器2806传输至/自并行处理单元2820的其他单元，例如一个或多个复制引擎、视频编码器、视频解码器、电源管理单元等（未明确显示）。NVLink 2816的更详细描述见65结合图32。

The I/O unit 2802 is configured to transmit and receive communications (e.g., commands, data, etc.) from a host

I/O单元2802被配置为发送和接收来自主机的通信（例如命令、数据等）。

US 11,770,215 B2

US 11,770,215 B2

21 processor (not shown) over the interconnect 2818. The I/O unit 2802 may communicate with the host processor directly via the interconnect 2818 or through one or more intermediate devices such as a memory bridge. In an embodiment, the I/O unit 2802 may communicate with one or more other processors, such as one or more parallel processing unit 2820 modules via the interconnect 2818. In an embodiment, the I/O unit 2802 implements a Peripheral Component Interconnect Express (PCIe) interface for communications over a PCIe bus and the interconnect 2818 is a PCIe bus. In alternative embodiments, the I/O unit 2802 may implement other types of well-known interfaces for communicating with external devices.

21处理器（未示出）通过互连2818。I/O单元2802可以直接通过互连2818或通过一个或多个中间设备（例如内存桥）与主机处理器通信。在一个实施例中，I/O单元2802可以通过互连2818与一个或多个其他处理器通信，例如一个或多个并行处理单元2820模块。在一个实施例中，I/O单元2802实现用于通过PCIe总线进行通信的外围组件互连快速（PCIe）接口，并且互连2818即为PCIe总线。在替代实施例中，I/O单元2802可以实现其他类型的已知接口，用于与外部设备进行通信。

The I/O unit 2802 decodes packets received via the interconnect 2818. In an embodiment, the packets represent commands configured to cause the parallel processing unit 2820 to perform various operations. The I/O unit 2802 transmits the decoded commands to various other units of the parallel processing unit specify. For example, some commands may be transmitted to the front-end unit 2804. Other commands may be transmitted to the hub 2806 or other units of the parallel processing unit 2820 such as one or more copy engines, a video encoder, a video decoder, a power management unit, etc. (not explicitly shown). In other words, the I/O unit 2802 is configured to route communications between and among the various logical units of the parallel processing unit 2820.

I/O单元2802对通过互连2818接收到的数据包进行解码。在一个实施例中，这些数据包表示用于使并行处理单元2820执行各种操作的命令。I/O单元2802将解码后的命令传输至并行处理单元2820的其他各个单元。例如，某些命令可能被传输到前端单元2804。其他命令可能被传输到集线器2806或并行处理单元2820的其他单元，例如一个或多个复制引擎、视频编码器、视频解码器、电源管理单元等（未明确示出）。换句话说，I/O单元2802被配置为在并行处理单元2820的各个逻辑单元之间和之中路由通信。

In an embodiment, a program executed by the host processor encodes a command stream in a buffer that provides workloads to the parallel processing unit 2820 for processing. A workload may comprise several instructions and data to be processed by those instructions. The buffer is a region in a memory that is accessible (e.g., read/write) by both the host processor and the parallel processing unit 2820. For example, the I/O unit 2802 may be configured to access the buffer in a system memory connected to the interconnect 2818 via memory requests transmitted over the interconnect 2818. In an embodiment, the host processor writes the command stream to the buffer and then transmits a pointer to the start of the command stream to the parallel processing unit 2820. The front-end unit 2804 receives pointers to one or more command streams. The front-end unit 2804 manages the one or more streams, reading commands from the streams and forwarding commands to the various units of the parallel processing unit 2820.

在一个实施例中，由主机处理器执行的程序将命令流编码到缓冲区中，该缓冲区为并行处理单元2820提供工作负载以供处理。工作负载可包含若干指令及由这些指令处理的数据。缓冲区是内存中的一个区域，主机处理器和并行处理单元2820均可访问（例如读/写）。例如，I/O单元2802可被配置为通过经由互连2818发送的内存请求，访问与互连2818相连的系统内存中的缓冲区。在一个实施例中，主机处理器将命令流写入缓冲区，然后将指向命令流起始位置的指针传输给并行处理单元2820。前端单元2804接收指向一个或多个命令流的指针。前端单元2804管理这（些）流，从流中读取命令并将命令转发给并行处理单元2820的各个单元。

The front-end unit 2804 is coupled to a scheduler unit 2808 that configures the various general processing cluster 2900 modules to process tasks defined by the one or more streams. The scheduler unit 2808 is configured to track state information related to the various tasks managed by the scheduler unit 2808. The state may indicate which general processing cluster 2900 a task is assigned to, whether the task is active or inactive, a priority level associated with the task, and so forth. The scheduler unit 2808 manages the execution of a plurality of tasks on the one or more general processing cluster 2900 modules.

前端单元2804耦合至调度器单元2808，该调度器单元配置各通用处理集群2900模块以处理由一个或多个流定义的任务。调度器单元2808被配置为追踪与由其管理的各任务相关的状态信息。该状态可指示任务被分配至哪个通用处理集群2900、任务是处于活动还是非活动状态、与任务相关的优先级等。调度器单元2808管理多个任务在一个或多个通用处理集群2900模块上的执行。

The scheduler unit 2808 is coupled to a work distribution unit 2810 that is configured to dispatch tasks for execution on the general processing cluster 2900 modules. The work distribution unit 2810 may track a number of scheduled tasks received from the scheduler unit 2808. In an embodiment, the work distribution unit 2810 manages a pending task pool and an active task pool for each of the general processing cluster 2900 modules. The pending task pool may comprise a number of slots (e.g., 32 slots) that contain tasks assigned to be processed by a particular general processing cluster 2900. The active task pool may comprise

调度器单元2808耦合至工作分发单元2810，该工作分发单元2810被配置为分派任务以供在通用处理集群2900模块上执行。工作分发单元2810可跟踪从调度器单元2808接收的已调度任务数量。在一个实施例中，工作分发单元2810为每个通用处理集群2900模块管理待处理任务池和活动任务池。待处理任务池可包括多个槽位（例如，32个槽位），其中包含分配给特定通用处理集群2900处理的任务。活动任务池可包括

a number of slots (e.g., 4 slots) for tasks that are actively being processed by the general processing cluster 2900 modules. As a general processing cluster 2900 finishes the execution of a task, that task is evicted from the active task pool for the general processing cluster 2900 and one of the other tasks from the pending task pool is selected and scheduled for execution on the general processing cluster 2900. If an active task has been idle on the general processing cluster 2900, such as while waiting for a data depen- 0 dency to be resolved, then the active task may be evicted from the general processing cluster 2900 and returned to the pending task pool while another task in the pending task pool is selected and scheduled for execution on the general processing cluster 2900.

若干槽位（例如，4个槽位）用于由通用处理集群2900模块主动处理的任务。当通用处理集群2900完成一个任务的执行时，该任务将从该通用处理集群2900的活动任务池中移出，然后从待处理任务池中选择另一个任务并调度到该通用处理集群2900上执行。如果活动任务在通用处理集群2900上处于空闲状态（例如在等待某个数据依赖被解决），那么该活动任务可能会从通用处理集群2900中移出并返回待处理任务池，同时从待处理任务池中选择另一个任务并调度到该通用处理集群2900上执行。

The work distribution unit 2810 communicates with the one or more general processing cluster 2900 modules via crossbar 2814. The crossbar 2814 is an interconnect network that couples many of the units of the parallel processing unit 2820 to other units of the parallel processing unit 2820. For 0 example, the crossbar 2814 may be configured to couple the work distribution unit 2810 to a particular general processing cluster 2900. Although not shown explicitly, one or more other units of the parallel processing unit 2820 may also be connected to the crossbar 2814 via the hub 2806.

工作分配单元2810通过交叉开关2814与一个或多个通用处理集群2900模块通信。交叉开关2814是一种互连网络，可将并行处理单元2820的众多单元彼此耦合。例如，交叉开关2814可配置为将工作分配单元2810耦合至特定的通用处理集群2900。尽管未明确展示，但并行处理单元2820的一个或多个其他单元也可经由集线器2806连接至交叉开关2814。

FIG. 29 depicts a general processing cluster 2900 of the parallel processing unit 2820 of FIG. 28, in accordance with an embodiment. As shown in FIG. 29, each general pro-

图29描绘了根据一个实施例的图28的并行处理单元2820的通用处理集群2900。如图29所示，每个通用处

23 cessing cluster 2900 includes a number of hardware units for processing tasks. In an embodiment, each general processing cluster 2900 includes a pipeline manager 2902, a pre-raster operations unit 2904, a raster engine 2908, a work distribution crossbar 2914, a memory management unit 2916, and one or more data processing cluster 2906. It will be appreciated that the general processing cluster 2900 of FIG. 29 may include other hardware units in lieu of or in addition to the units shown in FIG. 29.

23 cessing 集群 2900 包含多个用于处理任务的硬件单元。在一个实施例中，每个通用处理集群 2900 包括一个流水线管理器 2902、一个预光栅操作单元 2904、一个光栅引擎 2908、一个工作分发交叉开关 2914、一个内存管理单元 2916 以及一个或多个数据处理集群 2906。应理解，图 29 中的通用处理集群 2900 可以包括其他硬件单元，以替代或补充图 29 中所示的单元。

In an embodiment, the operation of the general processing cluster 2900 is controlled by the pipeline manager 2902. The pipeline manager 2902 manages the configuration of the one or more data processing cluster 2906 modules for processing tasks allocated to the general processing cluster 2900. In an embodiment, the pipeline manager 2902 may configure at least one of the one or more data processing cluster 2906 modules to implement at least a portion of a graphics rendering pipeline. For example, a data processing cluster 2906 may be configured to execute a vertex shader program on the programmable streaming multiprocessor 3100. The pipeline manager 2902 may also be configured to route packets received from the work distribution unit 2810 to the appropriate logical units within the general processing cluster 2900. For example, some packets may be routed to fixed function hardware units in the pre-raster operations unit 2904 and/or raster engine 2908 while other packets may be routed to the data processing cluster 2906 modules for processing by the primitive engine 2912 or the streaming multiprocessor 3100. In an embodiment, the pipeline manager 2902 may configure at least one of the one or more data processing cluster 2906 modules to implement a neural network model and/or a computing pipeline.

在一个实施例中，通用处理集群2900的操作由管线管理器2902控制。管线管理器2902管理一个或多个数据处理集群2906模块的配置，以处理分配给通用处理集群2900的任务。在一个实施例中，管线管理器2902可以配置一个或多个数据处理集群2906模块中的至少一个来实现图形渲染管线的至少一部分。例如，一个数据处理集群2906可以被配置为在可编程流式多处理器3100上执行顶点着色器程序。管线管理器2902还可以被配置为将从工作分配单元2810接收的数据包路由到通用处理集群2900内的适当逻辑单元。例如，一些数据包可以被路由到预光栅操作单元2904和/或光栅引擎2908中的固定功能硬件单元，而其他数据包可以被路由到数据处理集群2906模块，由图元引擎2912或流式多处理器3100进行处理。在一个实施例中，管线管理器2902可以配置一个或多个数据处理集群2906模块中的至少一个来实现神经网络模型和/或计算管线。

The pre-raster operations unit 2904 is configured to route data generated by the raster engine 2908 and the data processing cluster 2906 modules to a Raster Operations (ROP) unit, described in more detail in conjunction with FIG. 30. The pre-raster operations unit 2904 may also be configured to perform optimizations for color blending, organize pixel data, perform address translations, and the like.

预光栅操作单元2904被配置为将光栅引擎2908和数据处理集群2906模块所生成的数据路由到光栅操作（ROP）单元（结合图30进行了更详细描述）。预光栅操作单元2904还可被配置为执行颜色混合优化、组织像素数据、执行地址转换等操作。

The raster engine 2908 includes a number of fixed function hardware units configured to perform various raster operations. In an embodiment, the raster engine 2908 includes a setup engine, a coarse raster engine, a culling engine, a clipping engine, a fine raster engine, and a tile coalescing engine. The setup engine receives transformed vertices and generates plane equations associated with the geometric primitive defined by the vertices. The plane equations are transmitted to the coarse raster engine to generate coverage information (e.g., an x, y coverage mask for a tile) for the primitive. The output of the coarse raster engine is transmitted to the culling engine where fragments associated with the primitive that fail a z-test are culled, and transmitted to a clipping engine where fragments lying outside a viewing frustum are clipped. Those fragments that survive clipping and culling may be passed to the fine raster engine to generate attributes for the pixel fragments based on the plane equations generated by the setup engine. The output of the raster engine 2908 comprises fragments to be processed, for example, by a fragment shader implemented within a data processing cluster 2906.

In an embodiment, copy engines transfer data between multiple parallel processing unit2820modules or between parallel processing unit2820modules and CPUs. The copy engines can generate page faults for addresses that are not mapped into the page tables. The memory partition unit 3000 can then service the page faults, mapping the addresses into the page table, after which the copy engine can perform the transfer. In a conventional system, memory is pinned (e.g., non-pageable) for multiple copy engine operations between multiple processors, substantially reducing the available memory. With hardware page faulting, addresses can be passed to the copy engines without worrying if the memory pages are resident, and the copy process is transparent.

Cooperative Groups enables programmers to define groups of threads explicitly at sub-block (e.g., as small as a single thread) and multi-block granularities, and to perform collective operations such as synchronization on the threads in a cooperative group. The programming model supports clean composition across software boundaries, so that libraries and utility functions can synchronize safely within their local context without having to make assumptions about convergence. Cooperative Groups primitives enable new patterns of cooperative parallelism, including producer-consumer parallelism, opportunistic parallelism, and global synchronization across an entire grid of thread blocks.

协作组使程序员能够在子块（例如小至单个线程）和多块粒度上显式定义线程组，并对协作组中的线程执行同步等集合操作。该编程模型支持跨软件边界的清晰组合，从而使库和实用函数能够在本地上下文中安全地进行同步，而无需对线程的收敛情况做出假设。协作组原语支持新的协作并行模式，包括生产者-消费者并行、机会并行，以及跨整个线程块网格的全局同步。

每个流式多处理器3100包含L个处理核心3110模块。在一个实施例中，流式多处理器3100包括大量（例如128个等）不同的处理核心3110模块。每个核心3110可包含全流水线化的单精度、双精度和/或混合精度处理单元，该单元包括一个浮点算术逻辑单元和一个整数算术逻辑单元。在一个实施例中，浮点算术逻辑单元实现了IEEE 754-2008浮点算术标准。在一个实施例中，核心3110模块包含64个单精度（32位）浮点核心、64个整数核心、32个双精度（64位）浮点核心和8个张量核心。

Tensor cores configured to perform matrix operations, and, in an embodiment, one or more tensor cores are included in the core 3110 modules. In particular, the tensor cores are configured to perform deep learning matrix arithmetic, such as convolution operations for neural network training and inferencing. In an embodiment, each tensor core operates on a \(4 \times 4\) matrix and performs a matrix multiply and accumulate operation D=A'B+C, where A, B, C, and D are 4×4 matrices.

张量核心配置为执行矩阵运算，并且，在一个实施例中，一个或多个张量核心包含在核心3110模块中。具体地，张量核心配置为执行深度学习矩阵算术，例如用于神经网络训练和推理的卷积运算。在一个实施例中，每个张量核心对\(4 \times 4\)矩阵进行操作，并执行矩阵乘累加运算D=A'B+C，其中A、B、C和D是4×4矩阵。

In an embodiment, the matrix multiply inputs A and B are 16-bit floating point matrices, while the accumulation matrices C and D may be 16-bit floating point or 32-bit floating point matrices. Tensor Cores operate on 16-bit floating point input data with 32-bit floating point accumulation. The 16-bit floating point multiply requires 64 operations and results in a full precision product that is then accumulated using 32-bit floating point addition with the other intermediate products for a \(4 \times 4 \times 4\) matrix multiply. In practice, Tensor Cores are used to perform much larger two-dimensional or higher dimensional matrix operations, built up from these smaller elements. An API, such as CUDA 9 C++ API, exposes specialized matrix load, matrix multiply and accumulate, and matrix store operations to efficiently use

在一个实施例中，矩阵乘法的输入 A 和 B 是 16 位浮点矩阵，而累加矩阵 C 和 D 可以是 16 位浮点或 32 位浮点矩阵。Tensor Core 对 16 位浮点输入数据进行操作，并使用 32 位浮点进行累加。16 位浮点乘法需要 64 次运算，并产生一个全精度乘积，然后通过 32 位浮点加法将该乘积与其他中间乘积累加，以完成一个 \(4 \times 4 \times 4\) 的矩阵乘法。实践中，Tensor Core 用于执行由这些较小元素构建的、更大的二维或更高维矩阵操作。一个 API（如 CUDA 9 C++ API）提供了专门的矩阵加载、矩阵乘累加和矩阵存储操作，以高效使用

Tensor Cores from a CUDA-C++ program. At the CUDA level, the warp-level interface assumes \({16} \times {16}\) size matrices spanning all 32 threads of the warp.

从 CUDA-C++ 程序使用张量核心。在 CUDA 层面，线程束级接口假设 \({16} \times {16}\) 大小的矩阵，跨越了该线程束的所有 32 个线程。

Each streaming multiprocessor 3100 also comprises M 5 special function unit 3112 modules that perform special functions (e.g., attribute evaluation, reciprocal square root, and the like). In an embodiment, the special function unit 3112 modules may include a tree traversal unit configured to traverse a hierarchical tree data structure. In an embodiment,

The texture units implement texture operations such as filtering operations using mip-maps (e.g., texture maps of 20 varying levels of detail). In an embodiment, each streaming multiprocessor 3100 includes two texture units.

Each streaming multiprocessor 3100 includes an interconnect network 3116 that connects each of the functional units to the register file 3108 and the load/ store unit 3114 to the register file 3108 and shared memory/ L1 cache 3118. In an embodiment, the interconnect network

每个流式多处理器 3100 还包括 N 个加载/存储单元 3114 模块，这些模块实现共享内存/L1 缓存 3118 与 25 寄存器文件 3108 之间的加载和存储操作。每个流式多处理器 3100 包含一个互连网络 3116，该网络将每个功能单元连接到寄存器文件 3108，并将加载/存储单元 3114 连接到寄存器文件 3108 和共享内存/L1 缓存 3118。在一个实施例中，该互连网络

The shared memory/L1 cache 3118 is an array of on-chip memory that allows for data storage and communication between the streaming multiprocessor 3100 and the primitive engine 2912 and between threads in the streaming multiprocessor 3100. In an embodiment, the shared 40 memory/L1 cache 3118 comprises 128 KB of storage capacity and is in the path from the streaming multiprocessor 3100 to the memory partition unit 3000. The shared memory/L1 cache 3118 can be used to cache reads and writes. One or more of the shared memory/L1 cache 3118, level two cache 5 3004, and memory 2812 are backing stores.

共享内存/L1 高速缓存 3118 是一种片上存储器阵列，支持流式多处理器 3100 与图元引擎 2912 之间、以及流式多处理器 3100 内部线程之间的数据存储和通信。在一种实施例中，共享 40 内存/L1 高速缓存 3118 包含 128 KB 的存储容量，并位于从流式多处理器 3100 到内存分区单元 3000 的路径上。共享内存/L1 高速缓存 3118 可用于缓存读取和写入。共享内存/L1 高速缓存 3118、二级高速缓存 5 3004 和内存 2812 中的一个或多个构成后备存储。

Combining data cache and shared memory functionality into a single memory block provides the best overall performance for both types of memory accesses. The capacity is usable as a cache by programs that do not use shared 50 memory. For example, if shared memory is configured to use half of the capacity, texture and load/store operations can use the remaining capacity. Integration within the shared memory/L1 cache 3118 enables the shared memory/L1 cache 3118 to function as a high-throughput conduit for 55 streaming data while simultaneously providing high-bandwidth and low-latency access to frequently reused data.

将数据缓存和共享内存功能合并到单个内存块中，可为这两种类型的内存访问提供最佳的整体性能。对于不使用共享 50 内存的程序，该容量可用作缓存。例如，如果共享内存被配置为使用一半容量，纹理操作和加载/存储操作可以使用剩余的容量。集成在共享内存/L1 缓存 3118 内，使得共享内存/L1 缓存 3118 能够充当用于 55 流数据的高吞吐量管道，同时为频繁重用的数据提供高带宽和低延迟的访问。

When configured for general purpose parallel computation, a simpler configuration can be used compared with graphics processing. Specifically, the fixed function graphics 50 processing units shown in FIG. 28, are bypassed, creating a much simpler programming model. In the general purpose parallel computation configuration, the work distribution unit 2810 assigns and distributes blocks of threads directly to the data processing cluster 2906 modules. The threads in

55 a block execute the same program, using a unique thread ID in the calculation to ensure each thread generates unique results, using the streaming multiprocessor 3100 to execute

55 一个块执行相同的程序，在计算中使用唯一的线程 ID 以确保每个线程生成唯一的结果，使用流式多处理器 3100 来执行。

the program and perform calculations, shared memory/L1 cache 3118 to communicate between threads, and the load/ store unit 3114 to read and write global memory through the shared memory/L1 cache 3118 and the memory partition unit 3000. When configured for general purpose parallel computation, the streaming multiprocessor 3100 can also write commands that the scheduler unit 2808 can use to launch new work on the data processing cluster 2906 modules.

程序并执行计算，共享内存/L1缓存3118用于在线程间通信，加载/存储单元3114通过共享内存/L1缓存3118和内存分区单元3000读写全局内存。当配置为通用并行计算时，流多处理器3100还可以写入命令，调度器单元2808可使用这些命令在数据处理集群2906模块上启动新工作。

The parallel processing unit 2820 may be included in a desktop computer, a laptop computer, a tablet computer, servers, supercomputers, a smart-phone (e.g., a wireless, hand-held device), personal digital assistant (PDA), a digital camera, a vehicle, a head mounted display, a hand-held electronic device, and the like. In an embodiment, the parallel processing unit 2820 is embodied on a single semiconductor substrate. In another embodiment, the parallel processing unit 2820 is included in a system-on-a-chip (SoC) along with one or more other devices such as additional parallel processing unit 2820 modules, the memory 2812, a reduced instruction set computer (RISC) CPU, a memory management unit (MMU), a digital-to-analog converter (DAC), and the like.

并行处理单元2820可包含于台式电脑、笔记本电脑、平板电脑、服务器、超级计算机、智能手机（例如，无线手持设备）、个人数字助理（PDA）、数码相机、车辆、头戴式显示器、手持电子设备等之中。在一个实施例中，并行处理单元2820实施在单个半导体衬底上。在另一实施例中，并行处理单元2820与一个或多个其他设备一起包含在片上系统（SoC）中，这些设备诸如附加的并行处理单元2820模块、存储器2812、精简指令集计算机（RISC）CPU、内存管理单元（MMU）、数模转换器（DAC）等。

In an embodiment, the parallel processing unit 2820 may be included on a graphics card that includes one or more memory devices. The graphics card may be configured to interface with a PCIe slot on a motherboard of a desktop computer. In yet another embodiment, the parallel processing unit 2820 may be an integrated graphics processing unit (iGPU) or parallel processor included in the chipset of the motherboard.

docs.title: Exemplary Computing System
docs.text:
Systems with multiple GPUs and CPUs are used in a variety of industries as developers expose and leverage more parallelism in applications such as artificial intelligence computing. High-performance GPU-accelerated systems with tens to many thousands of compute nodes are deployed in data centers, research facilities, and supercomputers to solve ever larger problems. As the number of processing devices within the high-performance systems increases, the communication and data transfer mechanisms need to scale to support the increased bandwidth.

配备多个 GPU 和 CPU 的系统正广泛应用于各行各业，开发者得以在人工智能计算等应用中挖掘并利用更多并行性。拥有数十至数千个计算节点的高性能 GPU 加速系统被部署在数据中心、研究机构和超级计算机中，以解决日益庞大的难题。随着高性能系统内处理设备数量的增加，通信与数据传输机制也需随之扩展，以满足不断增长的带宽需求。

FIG. 32 is a conceptual diagram of a processing system 3200 implemented using the parallel processing unit 2820 of FIG. 28, in accordance with an embodiment. The processing system 3200 includes a central processing unit 3206, switch 3204, and multiple parallel processing unit 2820 modules each and respective memory 2812 modules. The NVLink 2816 provides high-speed communication links between each of the parallel processing unit 2820 modules. Although a particular number of NVLink 2816 and interconnect 2818 connections are illustrated in FIG. 32, the number of connections to each parallel processing unit 2820 and the central processing unit 3206 may vary. The switch 3204 interfaces between the interconnect 2818 and the central processing unit 3206. The parallel processing unit 2820 modules, memory 2812 modules, and NVLink 2816 connections may be situated on a single semiconductor platform to form a parallel processing module 3202. In an embodiment, the switch 3204 supports two or more protocols to interface between various different connections and/or links.

In an embodiment, the signaling rate of each NVLink 50 2816 is 20 to 25 Gigabits/second and each parallel processing unit module includes six NVLink 2816 interfaces (as shown in FIG. 32, five NVLink 2816 interfaces are included for each parallel processing unit module). Each NVLink 2816 provides a data transfer rate of 25 Gigabytes/second in 55 each direction, with six links providing 300 Gigabytes/ second. The NVLink 2816 can be used exclusively for PPU-to-PPU communication as shown in FIG. 32, or some combination of PPU-to-PPU and PPU-to-CPU, when the central processing unit 3206 also includes one or more 60 NVLink 2816 interfaces.

Each of the foregoing modules and/or devices may even be situated on a single semiconductor platform to form the exemplary processing system 3300. Alternately, the various modules may also be situated separately or in various combinations of semiconductor platforms per the desires of the user.

示例性处理系统3300还包括输入设备3308、并行处理模块3202以及显示设备3306，例如传统CRT（阴极射线管）、LCD（液晶显示器）、LED（发光二极管）、等离子显示器等。可通过键盘、鼠标、触摸板、麦克风等输入设备3308接收用户输入。上述各模块及/或设备甚至可共同设置于单一半导体平台上，以构成示例性处理系统3300。或者，各模块也可根据用户需要，分别设置或采用半导体平台的多种组合形式。

Further, the exemplary processing system 3300 may be coupled to a network (e.g., a telecommunications network, local area network (LAN), wireless network, wide area network (WAN) such as the Internet, peer-to-peer network, cable network, or the like) through a network interface 3304 for communication purposes.

此外，示例性处理系统 3300 可通过网络接口 3304 耦合到一个网络（例如，电信网络、局域网（LAN）、无线网络、广域网（WAN）如互联网、对等网络、有线网络等）以用于通信目的。

The exemplary processing system 3300 may also include a secondary storage (not shown). The secondary storage includes, for example, a hard disk drive and/or a removable storage drive, representing a floppy disk drive, a magnetic tape drive, a compact disk drive, digital versatile disk (DVD) drive, recording device, universal serial bus (USB) flash memory. The removable storage drive reads from and/or writes to a removable storage unit in a well-known manner.

示例性处理系统3300还可以包括辅助存储器（未示出）。辅助存储器例如包括硬盘驱动器和/或可移动存储驱动器，代表软盘驱动器、磁带驱动器、光盘驱动器、数字通用盘（DVD）驱动器、记录设备、通用串行总线（USB）闪存。可移动存储驱动器以公知方式从可移动存储单元读取和/或向其写入。

Computer programs, or computer control logic algorithms, may be stored in the main memory 3302 and/or the secondary storage. Such computer programs, when executed, enable the exemplary processing system 3300 to perform various functions. The main memory 3302, the storage, and/or any other storage are possible examples of computer-readable media.

计算机程序，或计算机控制逻辑算法，可存储在主存储器3302和/或辅助存储器中。此类计算机程序在执行时，使得示例性处理系统3300能够执行各种功能。主存储器3302、该存储器和/或任何其他存储器是计算机可读介质的可能示例。

The architecture and/or functionality of the various previous figures may be implemented in the context of a general computer system, a circuit board system, a game console system dedicated for entertainment purposes, an application-specific system, and/or any other desired system. For example, the exemplary processing system 3300 may take the form of a desktop computer, a laptop computer, a tablet computer, servers, supercomputers, a smart-phone (e.g., a wireless, hand-held device), personal digital assistant (PDA), a digital camera, a vehicle, a head mounted display, a hand-held electronic device, a mobile phone device, a television, workstation, game consoles, embedded system, and/or any other type of logic.

前述多幅附图所展示的架构和/或功能，可实施于通用计算机系统、电路板系统、专用娱乐游戏主机系统、特定应用系统及/或其他任意所需系统环境中。例如，示例性处理系统3300可呈现为台式计算机、膝上型计算机、平板计算机、服务器、超级计算机、智能手机（如无线手持设备）、个人数字助理、数码相机、车载设备、头戴式显示器、手持电子装置、移动电话设备、电视、工作站、游戏主机、嵌入式系统及/或其他任意逻辑形态。

While various embodiments have been described above, it should be understood that they have been presented by way of example only, and not limitation. Thus, the breadth and scope of a preferred embodiment should not be limited by any of the above-described exemplary embodiments, but should be defined only in accordance with the following claims and their equivalents.

虽然上文描述了各种实施例，但应当理解，它们仅以示例方式呈现，而非限制。因此，一个优选实施例的广度与范围不应受任何上述示例性实施例的限制，而应仅依据随附权利要求及其等同项来界定。

FIG. 34 is a conceptual diagram of a graphics processing pipeline 3400 implemented by the parallel processing unit 2820 of FIG. 28, in accordance with an embodiment. In an embodiment, the parallel processing unit 2820 comprises a 15 graphics processing unit (GPU). The parallel processing unit 2820 is configured to receive commands that specify shader programs for processing graphics data. Graphics data may be defined as a set of primitives such as points, lines, triangles, quads, triangle strips, and the like. Typically, a 0 primitive includes data that specifies a number of vertices for the primitive (e.g., in a model-space coordinate system) as well as attributes associated with each vertex of the primitive. The parallel processing unit 2820 can be configured to process the graphics primitives to generate a frame buffer (e.g., pixel data for each of the pixels of the display).

图34是根据一个实施例的、由图28的并行处理单元2820实现的图形处理管线3400的示意图。在一个实施例中，并行处理单元2820包括一个15图形处理单元(GPU)。并行处理单元2820被配置为接收指定着色器程序以处理图形数据的命令。图形数据可以被定义为一组图元，例如点、线、三角形、四边形、三角形条带等。通常，一个0图元包括指定该图元的多个顶点(例如，在模型空间坐标系中)的数据以及与图元的每个顶点相关联的属性。并行处理单元2820可以被配置为处理图形图元以生成帧缓冲区(例如，显示器每个像素的像素数据)。

The model data defines each of the objects that may be visible on a display. The 30 application then makes an API call to the driver kernel that requests the model data to be rendered and displayed.
